Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh my God. Okay, go into the bathroom, use whatever you want, just don't ever tell me what you did in there.

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Thank you! (He goes into the bathroom.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Where's Joey? His mom's on the phone.

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Monica Geller: He's in the bathroom. I don't think you wanna go in there!

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: C'mon, we're roommates! (He goes into the bathroom, screams, and runs back out.) My eyes!! My eyes!!

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Monica Geller: I warned you...

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Who is being loud?

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Oh, that would be Monica. Hey, listen, I wanna borrow a coupla things, Aurora spent the night, I really wanna make her breakfast.

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh, you got the whole night, huh?

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Yeah, well, I only have twenty minutes until Ethan, so, y'know.. (He starts to raid the fridge.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Ooh, do I sense a little bit of resentment?

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: No, no resentment, believe me, it's worth it. 'Kay? Y'know in a relationship you have these key moments that you know you'll remember for the rest of your life? Well, every- single- second is like that with Aurora.. and I've just wasted about thirty-five of them talking to you people, so, uh.. Monica, can you help me with the door? (He has armloads of stuff.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Sure. Oh, um, Chandler? Y'know, the-the old Monica would-would remind you to scrub that Teflon pan with a plastic brush...But I'm not gonna do that.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: (on phone)...Dammit, hire the girl! (He hangs up the phone.) Okay, everybody ready?

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Uh, listen, I just wanna thank you for this great opportunity.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: Lose the robe.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Me?

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: That would work.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Right. Okay. Losing the robe. (He takes off the robe.) And the robe is lost.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: Okay, everybody, we'd like to get this in one take, please. Let's roll it.. water's working (The shower starts).. and... action.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: And cut. Hey, Butt Guy, what the hell are you doing?

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Well, I'm- I'm showering.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: No, that was clenching.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Oh. Well, the way I see it, the guy's upset here, y'know? I mean, his wife's dead, his brother's missing... I think his butt would be angry here.

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Director: I think his butt would like to get this shot before lunch. Once again, rolling... water working... and action....and cut. What was that?

Friends S01E06, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: I was going for quiet desperation. But if you have to ask...

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: God, I love these fingers...

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Thank you.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: No, actually I meant my fingers. Look at 'em, look at how happy they are.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: (moves Chandler's arm and look at his watch.) Oh my God, I'm late. (She starts to get up.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Oh no nonononononnononono, don't go.. (He kisses her and pulls her back down.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Okay.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Don't go.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Okay. Oh no, I have to.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: (to himself) Too bad, she's leaving.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: (getting up and dressing) I'm sorry. He'll be waiting for me.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Well, I thought- I thought you talked to Rick.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: It's not Rick.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: What, Ethan? He got to spend the whole day with you!

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: No, it's-it's Andrew.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I know there'll be many moments in the years to come when I'll regret asking the following question, but- And Andrew is?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: He's... new.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Oh, so what you're saying is you're not completely fulfilled by Rick, Ethan and myself?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: No, that's not exactly what I was..

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Well, y'know, most women would kill for three guys like us.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: So what do you want?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: You.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: You have me!

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Nono, just you.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Whaddyou mean?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Lose the other guys.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: ...Like, ...all of them?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: C'mon, we're great together, why not?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Why can't we just have what we have now? Why can't we just talk, and laugh, and make love, without feeling obligated to one another... and up until tonight I thought that's what you wanted too.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: ...Well, y'know, part of me wants that, but it's like I'm two guys, y'know? I mean, one guy's going 'Shut up! This is great!' But there's this other guy. Actually it's the same guy that wells up every time that Grinch's heart grows three sizes and breaks that measuring device... And he's saying, y'know, 'This is too hard! Get out! Get out!'

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: So... which one of the two guys will you listen to?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I don't know, I-I have to listen to both of them, they don't exactly let each other finish...

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: Which one?

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: ...The second guy.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Aurora: (gets up to leave) Well, call me if you change your mind.

Friends S01E06, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Sorry, the first guy runs the lips.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Look at it this way: you dumped her. Right? I mean, this woman was unbelievably sexy, and beautiful, intelligent, unattainable... Tell me why you did this again?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
#ALL#: Hey!

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Hey, waitwait, aren't you the guy that plays the butt in the new Al Pacino movie?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Nope.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Ross Geller: No? What happened, big guy?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (to Ross) "Big guy?"

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Ross Geller: It felt like a 'big guy' moment.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I got fired.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
#ALL#: Oh!

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, they said I acted too much with it. I told everybody about this! Now everybody's gonna go to the theatre, expecting to see me, and...

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, Joey, you know what, no-one is gonna be able to tell.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: My mom will.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Something so sweet and...disturbing about that.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Y'know, I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years. And I finally get my shot, and I blow it!

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Maybe this wasn't your shot.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Yeah, I mean... I think when it's your shot, y'know, you-you know it's your shot. Did it... feel like your shot..?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Hard to tell, I was naked.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: No, I don't think this was your shot. I mean, I don't even think you just get one shot. I really believe big things are gonna happen for you, I do! You've gotta just keep thinking about the day that some kid is gonna run up to his friends and go 'I got the part! I got the part! I'm gonna be Joey Tribbiani's ass!'.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah? That's so nice! (They hug.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Monica Geller: I'm sorry, Joey. I'm gonna go to bed, guys.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
#ALL#: Night.

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Uh, Mon, you-you gonna leave your shoes out here?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (determined) Uh-huh!

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Really? Just casually strewn about in that reckless haphazard manner?

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Doesn't matter, I'll get 'em tomorrow. Or not. Whenever. (He goes to her room.)

Friends S01E06, Scene 8
Ross Geller: She is a kook.

Friends S01E06, Scene 9
Monica Geller: (hums for a while, then gives up, and in her head) If it bothers you that much, just go out and get the shoes. No. Don't do this. This is stupid! I don't have to prove anything, I'm gonna go get them...But then everyone will know. Unless I get them, and then wake up really early and put them back! ...I need help! (She buries her head in her pillow.)

Friends S01E07, Scene 1
Rachel Green: Everybody? Shh, shhh. Uhhh... Central Perk is proud to present the music of Miss Phoebe Buffay.

Friends S01E07, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Hi. Um, I want to start with a song thats about that moment when you suddenly realize what life is all about. OK, here we go. (plays a chord, then the lights go out) OK, thank you very much.

Friends S01E07, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Oh, great. This is just...

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wow, this is so cool, you guys. The entire city is blacked out!

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Mom says it's all of Manhattan, parts of Brooklyn and Queens, and they have no idea when it's coming back on.

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wow, you guys, this is big.

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Monica Geller: (into phone) Pants and a sweater? Why, mom? Who am I gonna meet in a blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters? Could we talk about this later? OK. (hangs up)

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Can I borrow the phone? I want to call my apartment and check on my grandma. (to Monica) What's my number?

Friends S01E07, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Well, I never call me.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Oh my God, it's that Victoria's Secret model. Something... something Goodacre.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Jill Goodacre: (on phone) Hi Mom, it's Jill.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: She's right, it's Jill. Jill Goodacre. Oh my God. I am trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre! (pause) Is it a vestibule? Maybe it's an atrium. Oh, yeah, that is the part to focus on, you idiot!

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Jill Goodacre: (on phone) Yeah, I'm fine. I'm just stuck at the bank, in an ATM vestibule.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Jill says vestibule... I'm going with vestibule.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Jill Goodacre: (on phone) I'm fine. No, I'm not alone... I don't know, some guy.

Friends S01E07, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Oh! Some guy. Some guy. 'Hey Jill, I saw you with some guy last night. Yes, he was some guy.

Friends S01E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Hi everyone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: And officiating at tonight's blackout, is Rabbi Tribbiani.

Friends S01E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Well, Chandler's old roomate was Jewish, and these are the only candles we have, so... Happy Chanukah, everyone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: (at window) Eww, look. Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.

Friends S01E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: That had to hurt!

Friends S01E07, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Alright, alright, alright. It's been fourteen and a half minutes and you still have not said one word. Oh God, do something. Just make contact, smile!

Friends S01E07, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: There you go!

Friends S01E07, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: You're definitely scaring here.

Friends S01E07, Scene 6
Jill Goodacre: (awkwardly) Would you like to call somebody? (offering phone)

Friends S01E07, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Yeah, about 300 guys I went to high school with. Yeah, thanks. (takes phone)

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Monica Geller: Hello?

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Hey, it's me.

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Monica Geller: (to everyone) It's Chandler! (on phone) Are you OK?

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Yeah, I'm fine. (trying to cover up what he is saying) I'm trppd in an ATM vstbl wth Jll Gdcr.

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Monica Geller: What?

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I'm trppd... in an ATM vstbl... wth Jll Gdcr!

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Monica Geller: I have no idea what you just said.

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: (angry) Put Joey on the phone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: What's up man?

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I'm trppd... in an ATM vstbl... wth JLL GDCR.

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: (to everyone) Oh my God! He's trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre! (on phone) Chandler, listen. (says something intentionally garbled)

Friends S01E07, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Yeah, like that thought never entered my mind.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Alright, somebody.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: OK, I'll go. OK, senior year of college... on a pool table.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
#ALL#: Whoooaa!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: That's my sister.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: OK... my weirdest place would have to be... the women's room on the second floor of the New York CIty public library.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh my God! What were you doing in a library?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Pheebs, what about you?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Oh... Milwaukee.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Um... Ross?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Disneyland, 1989, 'It's a Small World After All.'

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
#ALL#: No way!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: The ride broke down. So, Carol and I went behind a couple of those mechanical Dutch children... then they fixed the ride, and we were asked never to return to the Magic Kingdom.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, Rachel.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh come on, I already went.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: You did not go!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
#ALL#: Come on.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, alright. The weirdest place would have to be... (sigh)... oh, the foot of the bed.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Step back.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: We have a winner!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: I just never had a relationship with that kind of passion, you know, where you have to have somebody right there, in the middle of a theme park.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Well, it was the only thing to do there that didn't have a line.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: There, well, see? Barry wouldn't even kiss me on a miniature golf course.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Come on.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: No, he said we were holding up the people behind us.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (sarcastically) And you didn't marry him because...?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: I mean, do you think there are people who go through life never having that kind of...

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Probably. But you know, I'll tell you something. Passion is way overrated.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Yeah right.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: It is. Eventually, it kind of... burns out. But hopefully, what you're left with is trust, and security, and... well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism. So, you know, for all of those people who miss out on that passion... thing, there's all that other good stuff.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: (sigh) OK.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: But, um... I don't think that's going to be you.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: You don't.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Uh-uh. See, I see.... big passion in your future.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Really?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Mmmm.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: You do?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I do.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh Ross, you're so great. (she playfully rubs his head and gets up)

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: It's never gonna happen.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (innocently) What?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: You and Rachel.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (acts surprised) What? (pause) Why not?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend zone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: No, no, no. I'm not in the zone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Ross, you're mayor of the zone.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I'm taking my time, alright? I'm laying the groundwork. Yeah. I mean, every day I get just a little bit closer to...

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Priesthood! Look Ross, I'm telling you, she has no idea what you're thinking. If you don't ask her out soon you're going to end up stuck in the zone forever.

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I will, I will. See, I'm waiting for the right moment. (Joey looks at him) What? What, now?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeeeeaaaahhh! What's messing you up? The wine? The candles? The moonlight? You've just got to go up to her and say, 'Rachel, I think that...' (Rachel comes into the room behind them)

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Shhhh!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: What are you shushing?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: We're shushing... because... we're trying to hear something. Listen. (everyone is silent) Don't you hear that?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Ahhhh!

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Ross Geller: See?

Friends S01E07, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Huh. (she agrees, but looks very confused)

Friends S01E07, Scene 9
Jill Goodacre: Would you like some gum?

Friends S01E07, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Um, is it sugarless?

Friends S01E07, Scene 9
Jill Goodacre: (checks) Sorry, it's not.

Friends S01E07, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Oh, then no thanks. What the hell was that? Mental note: If Jill Goodacre offers you gum, you take it. If she offers you mangled animal carcass, you take it.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: (singing) New York City has no power, and the milk is getting sour. But to me it is not scary, 'cause I stay away from dairy.... la la la, la la, la la... (she writes the lyrics down)

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: (to Joey) OK, here goes.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Are you going to do it?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: I'm going to do it.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Do you want any help?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: You come out there, you're a dead man.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Good luck, man.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Thanks. (Joey hugs him) OK.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: OK. (Ross goes out on the balcony to talk to Rachel)

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, where are you going?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Outside.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: You can't go out there.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Why not?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Because of... the reason.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: And that would be?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: I, um, can't tell you.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Joey, what's going on?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: OK, you've got to promise that you'll never, ever tell Ross that I told you.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: About what?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: He's planning your birthday party.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh my God! I love him!

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: (as Phoebe enters) You'd better act surprised.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: About what?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: My surprise party!

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: What surprise party?

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh stop it. Joey already told me.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Well, he didn't tell me.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, don't look at me. This is Ross's thing.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: This is so typical. I'm always the last one to know everything.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Monica Geller: No, you are not. We tell you stuff.

Friends S01E07, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Yuh-huh! I was the last one to know when Chandler got bitten by the peacock at the zoo. I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in. (Monica gestures at Phoebe to shut up; Joey looks surprised but pleased) Looks like I was second to last.

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Hmmm... this is so nice.

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Ross Geller: OK, I have a question. Well, actually, it's not so much a question as.. more of a general wondering... ment.

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: OK.

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Ross Geller: OK. Here goes. For a while now, I've been wanting to, um....

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Ohhh!!!! (looking at something behind Ross)

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Yes, yes, that's right...

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Oh, look at the little cat! (a small kitten is on the roof behind Ross)

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Ross Geller: What? (the cat jumps on his shoulders) Ow!

Friends S01E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani & Monica Geller & Phoebe Buffay: (singing) I'm on top of the world, looking down on creation and the only explanation I can find, is the wonders I've found ever since...

text:
Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: (to Ross) This is just Bactine. It won't hurt.

Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Sorry, that was wax.

Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, poor little Tooty is scared to death. We should find his owner.

Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Ross Geller: Why don't we just put 'poor little Tooty' out in the hall?

Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Rachel Green: During a blackout? He'd get trampled!

Friends S01E07, Scene 12
Ross Geller: (nonchalantly) Yeah?

Friends S01E07, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: You know, on second thought, gum would be perfection. (Jill gives him a stick of gum, and a strange look) 'Gum would be perfection'? 'Gum would be perfection.' Could have said 'gum would be nice,' or 'I'll have a stick,' but no, no, no, no. For me, gum is perfection. I loathe myself.

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Phoebe Buffay: (stops at a door) Oh no, the Mendels, they hate all living things, right?

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Rachel Green: Oh. (they knock at the next door, Mr. Heckles answers) Hi. We just found this cat and we're looking for the owner.

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Mr. Heckles: Er, yeah, it's mine.

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Phoebe Buffay: (trying to hold back the struggling cat) He seems to hate you. Are you sure?

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Mr. Heckles: Yeah, it's my cat. Give me my cat.

Friends S01E07, Scene 14
Phoebe Buffay: Wait a minute. What's his name?

Phoebe Buffay: (She sees Monica sneaking out) Okay, thank you very much, I'm gonna take a short break! (Runs out, knocking over the mike stand)

Rachel Green: (Into mike) Okay, that was Phoebe Buffay, everybody. Woo!

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: What was that?

Ross Geller: Oh, uh, Phoebe just started a...

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Yeah, I believe I was talking to Joey, alright there, Mother-Kisser? (Goes to the counter)

Joey Tribbiani: (Laughing) Mother-Kisser... (Sees Ross's look) I'll shut up.

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Chandler, can I just say something? I-I know you're still mad at me, I just wanna say that there were two people there that night. Okay? Two sets of lips.

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Yes, well, I expect this from her. Okay? She's always been a Freudian nightmare.

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Okay, well, if she always behaves like this, why don't you say something?

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Because it's complicated, it's complex- Hey, you kissed my mom!

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Ross Geller: (To the rest of Central Perk) We're rehearsing a Greek play.

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: That's very funny. We done now?

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Ross Geller: No! Okay, you mean, you're not gonna talk to her, you're not gonna tell her how you feel?

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: That would be no. Look, just because you played tonsil tennis with my mom doesn't mean you know her. Alright? Trust me, you can't talk to her.

Friends S01E11, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Okay, 'you' can't, or (Points to Chandler) you can't? (Chandler grabs his finger) Okay, that's my finger. (Chandler twists it and Ross goes down on one knee) That's, that's my knee. (To Central Perk) Still doing the play. Aaah!

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Alright, whadyou do with him?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh! You're awake!

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Look at you! How, how do you feel?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: Uh, a little woozy, but basically okay.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: You look good!

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: I feel good! ...Who are you?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh, sorry.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I'm Phoebe Buffay.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I'm Monica Geller. I've been taking care of you.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Well, we both have.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: So, the Etch-a-Sketch is from you guys?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Well, actually it's just from me.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I got you the foot massager.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: You know who shaved you? That was me.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I read to you.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I sang. (To Monica) Hah!

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: Well,... thanks.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh, my pleasure.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: You're welcome.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: So. I guess I'll see you around.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: What, that's it?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: "See you around?"

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: Well, what do you want me to say?

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Oh, I don't know. Maybe, um, "That was nice?" Admit something to me? "I'll call you?"

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Coma Guy: Alright, I'll call you.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I don't think you mean that.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Monica Geller: This is so typical. Y'know, we give, and we give, and we give. And then- we just get nothing back! And then one day, y'know, it's just, you wake up, and "See you around!" Let's go, Phoebe.

Friends S01E11, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Y'know what? We thought you were different. But I guess it was just the coma.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: Car's waiting downstairs, I just wanted to drop off these copies of my book for your friends. Anything you want from Lisbon?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: No, just knowing you're gonna be there is enough.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: Alright, well, be good, I love you. (Kisses him and goes to leave)

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: You kissed my best Ross! ...Or something to that effect.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: (Reentering) O-kay. Look, it, it was stupid.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Really stupid.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: Really stupid. And I don't even know how it happened. I'm sorry, honey, I promise it will never happen again. Are we okay now?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Yeah. No. No...

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Ah, the forbidden love of a man and his door.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Shh. He did it. He told her off, and not just about the kiss, about everything.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: You're kidding.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: No, no. He said "When are you gonna grow up and start being a mom?"

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Wow!

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Then she came back with "The question is, when are you gonna grow up and realise I have a bomb?"

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: 'Kay, wait a minute, are you sure she didn't say "When are you gonna grow up and realise I am your mom?"

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: That makes more sense.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: So, what's going on now?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: I dunno, I've been standing here spelling it out for you! (Goes back to the door) I don't hear anything. Oh, wait, wait, wait. (Looks through the spyhole)

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Whaddya see?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Hard to tell, they're so tiny and upside-down. Wait, wait. They're walking away... they're walking away... No, no they're not, they're coming right at us! Run! Run!

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: You okay, kiddo?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Yeah, okay.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: Alright. (Kisses him)

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Nice save.

Ross Geller: (Very politely) Mrs. Bing.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Nora Tyler Bing: Mr. Geller.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Hey.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: You mean that?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Yeah, why not. (They shake hands) So I told her.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Yeah? How'd it go?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Awful. Awful. Couldn'ta gone worse.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Well, howdya feel?

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Pretty good! I told her.

Friends S01E11, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Well, see? So, maybe it wasn't such a bad idea, y'know, me kissing your mom, uh? Huh? (Wags his finger at Chandler, then puts it down) But.. we don't have to go down that road.

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Okay. Now this is just the first chapter, and I want your absolute honest opinion. Oh, oh, and on page two, he's not 'reaching for her heaving beasts'.

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Monica Geller: What's a 'niffle'?

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: You usually find them on the 'heaving beasts'.

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Alright, alright, so I'm not a great typist...

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Ross Geller: Wait, did you get to the part about his 'huge throbbing pens'? Tell ya, you don't wanna be around when he starts writing with those!

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Alright, that's it! Give it back! That's it!

Friends S01E11, Scene 12
#ALL#: Nooo!

Friends S01E12, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No-no-no-no, we're done.

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Aunt Syl, stop yelling! All I'm saying is that if you had told me vegetarian lasagna, I would have made vegetarian lasagna. (pauses, listens to person on phone) Well, the meat's only every third layer, maybe you could scrape.

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Ross, did you really read all these baby books?

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Yup! You could plunk me down in the middle of any woman's uterus, no compass, and I can find my way out of there like that! (snaps fingers)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Ooh, this is cool...it says in some parts of the world, people actually eat the placenta. (Joey grimaces)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: And, we're done with the yogurt. (Sets yogurt down on table)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: (softly) Sorry. (Camera pans back to Monica, still on phone)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Aunt Syl, I did this as a favor, I am not a caterer. What do you want me to do with a dozen lasagnas? (listens to Aunt Syl on phone, looks shocked) Nice talk, Aunt Syl. (in New York accent) You kiss Uncle Freddie with that mouth?

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Ross, listen, you know that right now, your baby's only this big? (measures about 2 inches with his thumb and index finger) This is your baby. (in baby-like voice) Hi Daddy!

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (waves) Hello!

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (in baby-like voice) How come you don't live with Mommy? (pause; shows Ross less than amused) How come Mommy lives with that other lady? (pause; Ross still looks less than amused; Joey smiling) What's a lesbian? (playfully hits Ross)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Honey, you can say it, Poconos, Poconos, it's like Poc-o-nos (touching Paolo's nose with forefinger with each syllable)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Paolo: Ah, poke (Paolo touches Rachel's nose) a (touches nose again) nose, mmm (they rub noses, then kisses her)

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller: (sitting in living room, imitating Paolo) Mma, Mma, Mmaah

text:
Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Monica Geller: So, did I hear Poconos?

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Yes, my sister's giving us her place for the weekend.

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Woo-hoo, first weekend away together!

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Yeah, that's a big step.

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Rachel Green: I know...

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: (to Ross) Ah, it's just a weekend, big deal!

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Wasn't this supposed to be just a fling, huh? Shouldn't it be...(makes flinging motions with hands) flung by now?

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Rachel Green: I mean, we are way past the fling thing, I mean, I am feeling things that I've only read about in Danielle Steele books, you know? I mean, when I'm with him, I'm totally, totally...

Friends S01E12, Scene 2
Ross Geller: ...nauseous, I'm physically nauseous. What am I supposed to do, huh? Call immigration? (pauses, looks suddenly inspired) I could call immigration!

Friends S01E12, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I love babies, with their little baby shoes, and their little baby toes, and their little baby hands...

Friends S01E12, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Ok, you're going to have to stop that, forever!

Friends S01E12, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Need a new table.

Friends S01E12, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: You think?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Hey hey, come on in!

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Hey, hello! mmwa! (kisses Carol) I brought all the books, and Monica sends her love, along with this lasagna.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Oh great! Is it vegetarian, 'cause Susan doesn't eat meat.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (pauses) I'm pretty sure that it is...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: So, I got the results of the amnio today.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (making flinging gestures with hands) Oh, tell me, tell me, is everything, uhh....?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Totally and completely healthy!

Ross Geller: Oh, that's great, that is great! (Hugs and kisses Carol. Then picks up a picture frame)

Ross Geller: Hey, when did you and Susan meet Huey Lewis?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Uh, that's our friend Tanya.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (surprised, chuckling nervously) Of course it's your friend Tanya. (looks up frightenedly)

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Don't you want to know about the sex?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (chuckles nervously) The sex? (chuckles) Um, I'm having enough trouble with the image of you and Susan together, when you throw in Tanya (miming washing hair, that's the best I could think of), yaw...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: The sex of the baby, Ross.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Oh, you know the sex of the baby? Oh, oh-oh-oh!

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Do you want to know?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: No, no, no, no, no, I don't want to know, absolutely not. I think, you know, I think you should know until you look down there, and say, oop, there it is! (pauses) Or isn't...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Susan Bunch: Oh, hello Ross!

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Susan...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Susan Bunch: So, so, did you hear?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yes, we did, everything's A-OK!

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Susan Bunch: Oh, that's so... (Susan hugs Carol, they giggle, Ross steps away) It really is...do we know...?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Yes, we certainly do, it's going to be...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (flailing arms in protest) Oh, hey hey hey, ho ho ho, hello, guy who doesn't want to know, standing right here!

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Susan Bunch: Oh, well, is it what we thought it would be?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Mm-hmmm (Susan and Carol hug, giggling. Ross stands back, reaches out and lightly taps Susan's shoulder)

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Ok, what, what...ok, what did we think it was going to be?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick & Susan Bunch: It's a...

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (interrupts) No, no, no I don't want to know, don't want to know. Ok, you know, I should probably, I should probably just go.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Well, thanks for the books.

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: No problem, ok, mmmwa (kisses Carol) oh, mmmwa (kisses Carol's stomach, then punches Susan's shoulder) Susan... (Ross leaves.)

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Susan Bunch: All right, who should we call first, your folks, or Deb and Rona? (intercom buzzer rings)

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Carol Willick: Hello?

Friends S01E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (on intercom) Uh, never mind, I don't want to know. (Carol and Susan laugh)

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Ok, so it's just because it was my table, I have to buy a new one?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: That's the rule.

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: What rule? There's no rule, if anything, you owe me a table!

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: How'd you get to that?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Well, I believe the piece of furniture was fine until your little breakfast adventure with Angela Delvecchio

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: You knew about that?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Well, let's just say the impressions you made in the butter left little to the imagination.

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Ok, ok, How about if we split it?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: What do you mean, like, buy it together?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: You think we're ready for something like that?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Why not?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Well, it's a pretty big commitment, I mean, what if one of us wants to move out?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Why, are you moving out?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: I'm not moving out.

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: You'd tell me if you were moving out right

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Yeah, yeah, it's just that with my last roommate Kip...

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Aw, I know all about Kip!

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: It's just that we bought a hibachi together, and then he ran off and got married, and things got pretty ugly.

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Well, let me ask you something, was Kip a better roommate than me?

Friends S01E12, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Aw, don't do that

Phoebe's Assistant: We've got a couple changes in your schedule. Your 4:00 herbal massage has been pushed back to 4:30 and Miss Somerfield canceled her 5:30 shiatsu.

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Ok, thanks. (assistant leaves, then walks back in)

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe's Assistant: Oh, here comes your 3:00. I don't mean to sound unprofessional, but, yum (walks out, Paolo enters)

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Paolo: Buon Giorno, Bella Phoebe!

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, Paolo, hi, what are you doing here?

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Paolo: Uh, Racquela tell me you massage, eh?

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Well, Racquela's right, yeah!

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, okay, I don't know what you just said, so let's get started.

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Paolo: Uh, I am, uh, being naked?

Friends S01E12, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Um, that's really your decision, I mean, some people prefer, you know, to take off...oh whoops! You're being naked!

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Rachel Green: (to Ross) I can't believe you don't want to know. I mean, I couldn't not know, I mean, if, if the doctor knows, and Carol knows, and Susan knows....

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Monica Geller: And Monica knows...

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Wha, heh, how could you know, I don't even know!

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Monica Geller: Carol called me to thank me for the lasagna, I asked, she told me.

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: So what's it gonna be? (Monica whispers in Joey's ear. Ross gets up and waves arms frantically in protest)

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Waitohheyhuh, oh great now he knows, and I don't know!

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Monica Geller: I'm sorry, I'm just excited about being an aunt!

Friends S01E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Or an uncle...

Friends S03E08, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Hey-hey, now he's showing us his poking device.

Friends S03E08, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, that's never gonna make it all the way over here, buddy!

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: (singing) I'll hold you close in my arms. (Phoebe enters) I can't resist your charms. And love....

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Phoebe Buffay: (joining him) Love....

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing & Phoebe Buffay: I'll be a fool for you. I'm sure, you know I don't mind.

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: (high pitched) No you know I don't mind.

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing & Phoebe Buffay: Yes! You mean the world the world to me. Oh...

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: I know.

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Phoebe Buffay: I know.

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: I've found.

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Phoebe Buffay: I've found....

Friends S03E08, Scene 13
Chandler Bing & Phoebe Buffay: ...in you, my endless (Phoebe goes high pitched, Chandler goes low pitched) love. (they both look at each other.) My endless love. (once again they don't match tones, and they just look at each other)

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
The Guys: (reacting to a play) Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Awww!

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Hey, it's your Thanksgiving too, y'know, instead of watching football, you could help.

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
The Guys: We will. (they don't move)

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Okay, Rachel, you wanna put the marshmellows in concentric circles.

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
Rachel Green: No Mon, you want to put them in concentric circles. I want to do this.

Friends S03E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Every year.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Y'know, for once, I am going to sit down and try to watch one of these things. (just as she sits down).

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Halftime.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, who wants to ah, throw the ball around a little, maybe get a little three on three going?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh! That would be sooo much fun!

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, can I play too? I've never played football, like ever.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Great, you can cover Chandler.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: No, no, no, I don't, I don't really wanna play.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Come on man! You never want to do anything since you and Janice broke up.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: That's not true! I wanted to wear my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters all day. I wanted to start drinking in the morning. Don't say that I don't have goals!

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Chandler, you have to start getting over her. All right, if you play, you get some fresh air, maybe it'll take your mind off Janice, and if you don't play, everyone will be mad at you 'cause the teams won't be even. Come on.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Yeah, all right, I'll play.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Yay!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Let's do it! Ross?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: What?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Do you wanna play football?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Um, Monica and I aren't supposed to play football.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Says who? Your mom?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller & Ross Geller: Yeah.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Well, every, every Thanksgiving um, we used to have a touch football game called the 'Geller Bowl.'

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: No, no, no, you say that proudly.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Anyway, Ross and I were always captains, and um, it got kind've competitive and one year, Geller Bowl VI, I accidentally broke Ross's nose.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: It was soo not an accident. She saw I was about to tag her, so she threw her big fat grandma arm elbow right into my face. And just keep running.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: To score the winning touchdown, by the way.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Whoa, whoa, whoa, ho, ho, ho, you did not win the game, the touchdown didn't count, because of the spectacularly illegal, oh and by the way savage nose breaking.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: (to Chandler and Joey) I won the game.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Oh yeah! Then how come you didn't get the Geller Cup?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Um, there was a Geller Cup?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Yes, it was the trophy you got if you won the game. But our Dad said, 'nobody won that game, ' and he was sick of our fighting, so he took the trophy and.... (pauses to collect himself, as he is on the verge of tears saying this) threw it in the lake.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: And was the curse lifted?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Anyway. That's when our Mom said we were not to play football ever again.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Y'know what, I think we should play a game. I mean come on, it's been twelve years.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Can I see you for a second?

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: (shouting) Once!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: All right, we're gonna play.

Friends S03E09, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: But wait a minute though, how are we gonna get there, though, because my Mom won't let me cross the street.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Okay. Let's bring it in.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wait no, honey, honey throw it to me, throw it to me.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Here you go. (throws her the ball)

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: (knocking it down instead of catching it) That almost hit me in the face.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: All right, we have to pick captains.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: And then Tineals.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, so how do we decide that?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Well, why don't we just bunny up.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Rachel Green: What?

metadata.speaker: Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Rachel Green

text:
Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller & Ross Geller: (holding both of their hands above their heads making rabbit ears with their fingers.) Bunny!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Okay, looks like Ross and I are captains. Okay, so um, I bunnied first so that means I get to pick first. Joey.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Thank you.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Monica, I'm your best friend.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Sweetie, don't worry you'll get picked. Chandler.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Ross!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Phoebe.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Sweetie, now I pick you.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: You don't pick me! You're stuck with me!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Okay. All right. So let's see, let's play from the trash can, to the lightpost. Right. Two hand touch, we'll kick off.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: All right people listen, I've got exactly twenty-eight minutes before I have to baste again.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Wow! Just like in the pros.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Huddle up.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: (to his team) All right, huddle up, right over here.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Wait for me! Wait for me! Wait for me! Oh cool, this is my first huddle.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Okay.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, so what do you guys really think of Chandler?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Okay, Phoebe you know what you're doing right?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Okay, Joey's gonna catch it, and you and I are gonna block.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: What's block?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Phoebe, I thought you said you know what you're doing?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: I thought you meant in life.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Break.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: The ball is Janice. The ball is Janice. (goes to kick the ball but kicks Ross's foot instead.)

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Oww!! Son of a...!! Ow! Come on!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Sorry. I'm sorry. Y'know what, we're just gonna throw it.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I got it. (catches the ball)

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Go! Go! Go!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Score!! 7 to nothing!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: (coming over to Ross, who is just getting up) Are you okay?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Come on, let's go!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Losers walk!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Yeah, losers talk!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: No, no, no, actually losers rhyme.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: (coming up under center, just like a real quarterback does, and puts his hands between Ross's legs.) Twenty-three!! Seventy-four!! (Ross stands up and looks at him) You wanna go shotgun?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Yeah!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: (from the shotgun) Hike!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani & Monica Geller: One-Mississippi. Two-Mississippi. Three-Mississippi.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Over here!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: (proud of her self) I almost caught that one!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Great! Now, the score is 7 to almost 7.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Okay, (to Chandler) this play, I want you to do a down and out to the right. Okay. Break!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wait, what am I gonna do?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: You, you go long.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wait, how long?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Until we start to look very small.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Okay.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Break!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Set....hike!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: One-Mississippi, two-Mississippi, switch! Switch! Switch!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: No, no, no, no, no!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Haaaaa! Hey-hey, thanks for stopping our ball.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Woman: (in a foreign accent) You are playing American football?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah! Wow, your like from a whole other country.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Woman: I'm Dutch.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Hi-hi, I'm Joey.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Woman: I'm Margha.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I'm sorry Dutch, I didn't get that last little bit.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: (running up) Hey Joey, do you wanna play football or you wanna.. (sees Marhan) Hi, I'm Chandler.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Margha: Hello, Chandler.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Her name is Dutch, and also Marklan.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Margha: Margha.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Mar-klan.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Margha: Mar-gha.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Mar-haaaan.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Come on guys! Let's go! Come on, it's second down.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Uh, hello, it's third down.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: No it's not, it's second.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Wow!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Wow, what?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: It just amazes me that your still pulling stuff like this.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Pulling what? It's second down.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Okay, it's second down. (turns away) Take all the second downs you need.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: I heard that!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Well, I said it loud.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Margha: It is okay, if I stay and watch?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani: Yeah! Why don't you stick around. You can sit right there.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Well, that went well.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I think so.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Y'know, I was thinking about ah, asking her for her number.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Thanks man, but I think it makes a stronger statement if I ask for it myself, y'know.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Whoa-ho, whoa! No, I was thinking about y'know for me, as a part of that whole getting over Janice thing you were talking about.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, yeah, that. All right, means that much to ya, I'll let you have her.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Thanks. What, let me have her?! What do mean? Like if you didn't I wouldn't have a shot?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Well I don't like to say it out loud, but, yeah! Don't feel bad man, we all have our strengths. You're better with numbers and stuff.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Math!! You're giving me math! All right, look y'know what, forget about it, you go for the girl, we'll see who gets her.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Chandler, I want you to run a post pattern to the left, okay. And sweetie..

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Yeah, I know, go long. Y'know, it's like all I'm doing is running back and forth from the huddle.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Well ah, you wanna just stay out there?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Can I see that for second.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Yeah.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Okay. Hut! Hike!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Fumble!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: What the hell's the matter with you?! This is my favourite jersey.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Well now you have two. Hey, I am good at math.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: All right, that's it. Y'know I was still gonna let you have her. But now, forget about it. Prepare to feel very bad about yourself.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Hey! Well, I've been preparing for that my entire life! Or something about you that's mean!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: All right, come on guys, let's go! Tie score, and we're runnin' out of time. Forty-two!! Thirty-eight!! Hike! (the timer sounds as Monica throws the ball to Phoebe.)

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Oh I got it!! (catches the ball) Oh! Ew! Broken boob! Ow!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Pheebs, run!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Run, Phoebe, run!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Touchdown!! Touchdown!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Uh, hello, the buzzer buzzed. It doesn't count.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: After the snap!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Before the snap!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: After!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Before!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Now, does it really matter?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
#ALL#: Yes!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Well, okay, I made a touchdown. It was my first touchdown. So?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Oh Pheebs, that's great. It doesn't count.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Does so count!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Cheater, cheater, compulsive eater.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Oh my God!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Y'know what, that's fine, maybe you haven't grown up, but I have.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Oh-ho, okay.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Dead leg!! (kicks him in the thigh.)

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Ow! Ow! Okay, okay, fine, fine! All right, you wanna win by cheating, go ahead, all right. Phoebe the touchdown does count, you win.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Woo-yay!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: No! Listen, I'm not gonna go through this with you again, okay. Just once I wanna beat when you can't blame it on the broken nose, the buzzer, or the fact that you thought you were getting mono. Let's just call this, tie score and it's halftime.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Okay, first of all, I don't play with cheaters, and second of all, you know I had swollen glands!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Y'know what? I'll think you'll play.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Oh really! Why is that?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Because the winner gets this!

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Ross Geller: The Geller Cup.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Is everybody else seeing a troll doll nailed to a two by four?

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
#ALL#: Yeah.

Friends S03E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Okay, good.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Okay, where in the hell did you get that?!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: When Mom and Dad drove you to the hospital to get your nose fixed, I swam into the lake and fished it out.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: That cup is mine!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: No it's not! You want it, you're gonna have to win it!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Rachel Green: All right, so are we not having dinner at all?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Come on Phoebe, let's go! Come on, it's time to get serious, huddle up. Joey, keep your head in the game.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: It's hard, y'know, his huddle is closer to Dutch girl.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: All right look, if I take Chandler out of the running will you be able to focus?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: What are you gonna do?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: All right, you just make sure that Chandler catches the ball, I'll take care of the rest.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Okay.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Break!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Here you go!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Chandler! Chandler!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: (to Margha) Hi.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Whoa! Whoa!! Tackled by a girl! Bet ya don't see that everyday, do ya?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What's with the tackling?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: What?! I just touched him and he went over.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Okay, you wanna play rough, we can play rough.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I love this game!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Hey, where'd you get that?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Rachel Green: I went really long.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Forty-two to twenty-one! Like the turkey, Ross is done!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: It's no surprise that your winning, 'cause you got to pick first, so you got the better team.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: You're so pathetic! Why can't you just accept it, we're winning because I'm better than you.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Oh, what a great argument, exhaling! All right, y'know what, I'll prove it to you, okay. I'll trade you Joey for Rachel, and I'll still win the game.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: What?! The guys against the girls? See, that's ridiculous Monica, because I'm only down by three touchdowns.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Oh, then bring it on! Oh, unless of course your afraid you might lose to a bunch of girls.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Fine, fine, Rachel your with Monica, Joey you're with me.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Rachel Green: I can not believe your trading me!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Come on Rach, come on. Let's see what's it like to be on a winning team for a change.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Are you gonna let me play?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: All right then.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: (coming over) The game is over, we eat now?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: No-no-no-no, the game's not over, we're just switching teams.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, Chandler finds me so intimdating that it's better if we're on the same team.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Right. Okay, let's play. Let's go.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: No ah, hold on a second Joe, where do Dutch people come from?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Ah well, the ah, Pennsylvania Dutch, come from Pennsylvania.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: And the other ah, Dutch people, they come on from somewhere near the Netherlands, right?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Nice try. (to Margha) See the Netherlands is this make believe place where Peter Pan and Tinker Bell come from.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: Oh, my.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Enough with geography for the insane, okay? Let's play some ball, guys.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Whoa, whoa, no, no, I-I'm not playing with this guy, now.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Fine with me.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Okay, y'know what, let's just cut to the chase here. Okay? Heidi, which of my boys do you like?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani: What are you doing? What are you doing? What are you doing?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: Which do I like?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah, y'know for dating, general merriment, taking back to your windmill...

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: Well, if I had to chose right now, which by the way I find really weird, I would have to say, Chandler.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Yes!!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Wait a minute! Wait a minute! She obviously didn't understand the question.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Well, you don't you have Captain Hook explain it to her.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: I'm sorry, Joey, that is my chose.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: You hear that! That is her chose, mister I'll let you have her! I win! You suck! I rule all! A mini-wave in celebration of me!! (does the wave.)

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: I'm now thinking I would like to change my answer to, no one.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Wh-what?

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Margha: I now find you shallow and um, a dork. All right, bye.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Nice going. You just saved yourself a couple months of sex.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Y'know what, it doesn't matter, 'cause she picked me. Me! From now on I get the dates and you have to stay home on Saturday nights watching Ready, Set, Cook!

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Save the breakthroughs for therapy, okay. The clock is ticking. We have no time, and we are losing, we are losing to girls.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: We're not gonna lose to girls.

Friends S03E09, Scene 4
