Joey Tribbiani: But Jo's got a crush on Laurie. (Ross nods his head) Oh. You mean it's like a girl-girl thing? 'Cause that is the one thing missing from The Shining.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: No, actually Laurie's a boy.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: No wonder Rachel had to read this so many times.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Hey!

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Hey.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Hey! How'd the ah, basketball go?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, okay, I learned how to shoot a lay-up, a foul shot, and a twenty-three pointer.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: You mean a three pointer?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, I get more because I'm dainty.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Robert Bobby: So um, is there a phone here, I can check my messages?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, in the back. You want a quarter?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Robert Bobby: Oh, no thanks. I always carry one in my sock.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: (noticing Chandler) What are you doing? (he pushes Chandler back to his side of the couch) Get back over on your side of the... (sees Robert in all his glory) Hello!! (to Robert) Hi, I'm Joey, we haven't met.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Robert Bobby: Ah, good to meet you. Robert.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: What? (the guys keep laughing.) What? You guys, what is going on? You not like Robert? (the guys keep laughing.) Why are you laughing?!

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Calm down. There's no reason to get testy.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: You guys!! Come on!

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, it just seems that Robert isn't as concealed in the shorts area, as ah, one may have hoped.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: What do you mean?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Robert Bobby: Hey. (sits down)

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Hey.

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Robert, could you ah, ha, pass me those cookies?

Friends S03E13, Scene 7
Robert Bobby: Sure.

Friends S03E13, Scene 8
Monica Geller: So, how'd the lasagne go over? (listens) Really?! Good. So you owe me three pretty things. (listens) Yeah, I've been thinking a lot about you too. (listens) I know. It's hard this whole platonic thing. (listens) It's a word!

Friends S03E13, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Yeah, I do think it's better this way. (listens) Yeah, we're being smart. (gets up to answer the door) (listens) Yes, I'm sure.(she opens the door and it's Richard)

Friends S03E13, Scene 8
Richard Burke: You really sure?

Friends S03E13, Scene 8
Monica Geller: I'll call you back. (starts kissing him)

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Monica Geller: So we can be friends who sleep together.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Richard Burke: Absolutely, this will just be something we do, like racquetball.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Sounds smart and healthy to me. So um, just out of curiosity, um, do you currently have any other racquetball buddies?

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Richard Burke: Just your dad. (pause) Although that's actually racquetball. You know I-I do have a blind date with my sister's neighbour next Tuesday.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Oh.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Richard Burke: You want me to cancel it?

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Monica Geller: No! (pushes him) No!

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Richard Burke: Okay.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Monica Geller: 'Cause if you do that means you'd be cancelling it for me, and we're just friends.

Friends S03E13, Scene 9
Richard Burke: Exactly. (pushes her back)

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: Hey.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Hey. Ooh! Don't sit down!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: You ready to go to the batting cage?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah. And, first here's a gift.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: Oh! Wow! Hey!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Chandler Bing: Stretchy pants! Why, those are the greatest things in the world! If I were you I would wear them every day, every day!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: Jeez, thank you really that is so nice. But um, to be honest, I don't think I can wear these, they're so tight, I feel like I'm on display. I'm sorry.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: That's all right, that's well, I figured.... (they start to leave as Joey enters.)

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: (to Joey) Hey!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Hey! (starts to laugh.) How's it going?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Good.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, Rach, how you doing with The Shining?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Oh, Danny just went into room 217.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Oooh, the next part's the best, when that dead lady in the bathtub...

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Oh, no, meh-nah-nah-nah, come on you're gonna ruin it!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: All right I'll talk in code. (to Ross and Chandler) Remember when the kid sees those two blanks in the hallway?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Chandler Bing: Hmmm, that's very cool.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, all blank, and no blank, make's blank a blank blank. Oh no-no-no, no, the end when Jack almost kills them all with that blank, but then at last second they get away. Aww!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Joey! I can't believe you just did that!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Chandler Bing: I can't believe she cracked your code!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: All right, okay, Laurie proposes to Jo, and she says no, even though she's still in love with him, and then he ends up marring Amy.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Hey! Mine was by accident! All right, the boiler explodes and destroys the hotel, and kills the dad.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Eh. Beth dies.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Beth, Beth dies?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Um-hmm.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Is that true? If I keep reading is Beth gonna die?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Chandler Bing: No, Beth doesn't die, she doesn't die. Does she Rachel?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: What?!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Joey's asking if you've just ruined the first book he's ever loved that didn't star Jack Nicholson?

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: No. She doesn't die.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Then why would you say that?!

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Because, I wanted to hurt you.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: (running in) Oh, there they are! I-I dropped my keys.

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Rachel Green: (gasps) Oh my....

Friends S03E13, Scene 10
Robert Bobby: Got 'em.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Monica Geller: Hi.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Rachel Green: (screams and grabs a potato masher to defend herself) Sorry. I'm sorry.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Monica Geller: You would not believe my day! I had to work two shifts, and then to top it off, I lost one of my fake boobs, (opens her coat revealing a large burn mark over her left breast.) in a grill fire.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Monica Geller: What are you smiling at?

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Rachel Green: I'm sorry, I was just thinking you're day could still pick up.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Monica Geller: Yeah, right.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Richard Burke: Hello.

Friends S03E13, Scene 11
Monica Geller: I love this friend thing!

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Listen, Robert's gonna be here any second so, will one of you just tell him?

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Ross Geller: Oh.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Please, right now, no, every time I see him it's like 'Is it on the lose?' 'Is it watching me?'

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: We can't tell him, you can't go up to a guy you barely know and talk about his.... stuff.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Ross Geller: He's right, even if it's to say something complementary. (He stops and thinks about what he just said.)

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Robert Bobby: (entering) Hey!

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Hey.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Robert Bobby: (to Phoebe) So are ready for the gym? They've got this new rock climbing wall, we can spot each other.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: No, I can spot you from here.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Robert Bobby: What?

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, listen Robert...

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Ross Geller: (to Chandler) Hey, don't we have to...

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Yeah, we got, um-hmm.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Umm, I think you're really, really great...

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Robert Bobby: Oh God! Here we go again. Why does this keep happening to me? (spreads his legs) Is it something I'm putting out there? Is this my fault? Or am I just nuts?

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: I-I-I-I-I don't know, I don't know what to say.

Friends S03E13, Scene 12
Gunther: (cleaning up the table) (to Robert) Hey buddy, this is a family place, put the mouse back in the house.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: Ow!

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: (outside the bedroom) Really?! Well, it's just like everyone else's apartment. It's got rooms, walls, and ceilings.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard's Date: Well, I just wanted to see where you lived. Now, give me the tour.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: Oh my God! Oh my God! (She frantically tries to clean up the bedroom as Richard starts the tour.)

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Ah well, this is the living room.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard's Date: Impressive.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: All right. This is the kitchen.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard's Date: Oh, that's real pretty. Wait a minute, don't I get to see the bedroom?

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: The bedroom. Well it's pretty much your typical... (opens the door as Monica hides under the covers, and quickly closes the door before his date can see the room.) bedroom.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard's Date: We're still on this side of the door.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Um-hmm.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard's Date: Yeah, but I didn't get to see it.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Oh shoot! Maybe next time. (yawns) Thanks for a lovely evening. (shows her out)

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: (still hiding under the blankets) So um, who was she?

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Oh, (laughs) that was the blind date that I told you about, she called and switched it to today.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: (still hiding under the blankets) Did you like her? And I'm just asking as a friend, because I am totally fine with this.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Well, you seem fine.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: (gets up) Okay, y'know what, I'm not fine, I'm not. I mean how can I be fine, hearing you come in with her, she wants to see your bedroom.... (pause) Y'know what, what if we're friends who don't see other people?

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: You mean like exclusive friends?

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: Why not?! I mean this has been the most amazing week. Would it be so terrible? Even if we were friends who lived together. Or, maybe someday friends who stood up in front of their other friends, and vowed to be friends forever.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Wow. Y'know we're back where we were. Honey, I would love to do all that, but nothing's changed.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: That's not true, you don't have a moustache.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: Okay, okay, one thing's changed. But we still want different things and we know how this is gonna end.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: Y'know what, I've got to walk out of here right now, 'cause getting over you is the hardest thing that I have ever had to do. I don't think I could do it again.

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: I know I couldn't. So....

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: How 'bout one last game of racquetball?

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Monica Geller: Watch the thorns!

Friends S03E13, Scene 13
Richard Burke: (lying down) Ow!!

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Rachel Green: What?

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Joey Tribbiani: Beth is really, really sick.

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Rachel Green: Awwww.

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Joey Tribbiani: Jo's there, but I don't think there's anything she could do.

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Rachel Green: Joey?

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah.

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Rachel Green: Do you want to put the book in the freezer?

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Joey Tribbiani: (nodding his head) Okay.

Friends S03E13, Scene 14
Rachel Green: Okay.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Singer: (singing) 'Cause every time I see your face, I can't help but fall from grace. I know.....

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani: Wow! This girl is good.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Oh-ho yeah! A song with rhyming words. Oo, I never thought of that before.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: I like her.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: (to Chandler) Why? Because she can sing and play guitar and do both at the same time?

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Well, that's pretty much all I'm looking for from these people.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Monica Geller: (to Phoebe) Look at you. All jealous.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Yeah Pheebs, come on, you two have completely different styles. Y'know, she's more..(shakes his shoulders, like he's dancing) y'know, and you're more (sees the look from Phoebe and stops)

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Singer: (singing) beside meeeee-eeee-ee. (everyone applauds her).

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, see, see, everyone else is happy she's done.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Singer: Okay, my next song's called Phoebe Buffay, What Can I Say. I Really Loved When We Were Singing Partners, And I Shouldn't Have Left You That Way.

Friends S03E14, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Oh no, one of those 'look for the hidden meaning' songs.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Singer: Hey Phoebe.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Hey Leslie, how'd you know I'd be here?

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: I ran into Vlad at the place where they sell the big fish, and he said you played here a lot, so umm....

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: (to Ross) All right listen, I have to go to the bathroom, but if the place with the big fish comes up again. I'd like know whether that's several big fish or just one big fish.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (to Leslie) So ah, Phoebe tells us you write jingles.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Actually I said she abandoned me to write jingles.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (to Leslie) Ah, anything we might of heard of?

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: Ah, yeah, umm. (singing) Home is never far away..

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani & Monica Geller & Ross Geller: (joining in) Home is Home Star stew.

text:
Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: Yeah, but, I don't do that anymore. I got kinda sick of it, and then I couldn't come up with anything good, so they fired me.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Hmm, bummer.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: Well, I y'know, I was just, umm, I was just thinking and hoping, that umm, maybe you'd want to get back together?

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: No. But thanks.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: Aw come on Phoebe would you just think about it?

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Okay. No. But thanks.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Leslie: Okay, ah, see ya Pheebs. (leaves)

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (to Phoebe) Wow, that was kinda brutal.

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Well okay, let this be a lesson to all of you, all right. Once you, once you betray me, I become like the ice woman, y'know. Very cold, hard, unyielding, y'know nothing, nothing can penetrate this icy exterior. (to Monica) Can I have a tissue, please?

Friends S03E14, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Yeah, sure.

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Gunther: (to Chandler) Someone in there?

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: No. This is just part of a dare devil game that I play called 'wait until the last moment before I burst and die.'

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Jeez, man did you fall..(sees it's a beautiful woman coming out of the men's room) Hi! So ah, did ya, did-did-did ya fall high?

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Woman: Someone was in the lady's room, I couldn't wait. I left the lid up for ya though.

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: (to Gunther) Y'know what Gunther, go ah, go ahead, I'm-I'm talking to ah, (tries to get her to say her name). (to her) This is the part where you say your name.

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Woman: Ginger.

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Ginger. I'm talking to Ginger, so....

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Ginger: Don't you have to use the bathroom?

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Nope, nope, I'd just ah, I'd rather talk to you. (pause) Yes, I do. Yes, I do have to go to the bathroom. (knocks on the door)

Friends S03E14, Scene 3
Gunther: Someone in here.

Friends S03E14, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Where's Chandler?

Friends S03E14, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Ah, he can't make it, he said he had to his... (sees Ginger) Whoa-oh! (hides behind the coat rack.)

Friends S03E14, Scene 4
Ginger: Joey? Joey Tribbiani?

Friends S03E14, Scene 4
Ginger: Joey I can see you okay? You're hiding behind the coats.

Friends S03E14, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Phew, close one.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Hi.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Hi, sweetie!

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Hello.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Mark Robinson: Hi, Ross.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Yeah, huh.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: I've got some bad news.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: What?

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: I can get a quick bite to eat, but then I have to come back up here.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Come on sweetie! You've had to work late every night for the past two weeks, what is it this time?

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Mark Robinson: Actually, it's kinda my fault. I-I quit today.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: (to Rachel) But work comes first! (to Mark) Oh hey, but that's sad about you though, what happened? Burn out? Burn all out, did ya?

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Nooo, he's leaving for a better job.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Oh well that's great, so I guess this is ah, this is good bye then. Huh? (picks a pad up off Rachel's desk and tosses it into his box) Good bye.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Mark Robinson: Okay, then.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Okay.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Well we're gonna miss you around here.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Mark Robinson: Yeah, me too.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Mark Robinson: So, see ya on Saturday.

Friends S03E14, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Yeah, you bet.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Oh. (takes her beeper puts in a pot, covers it, and puts the pot in the oven)

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Y'know those are a delicacy in India.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, that was Leslie calling again to see if we can get back together. That's the twentieth time today! And good luck Leslie!

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Wow, she must have hurt you pretty bad, huh?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Well, yeah. Y'know, we were best friends, ever since we were little, our Moms worked on the barge together.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Oh, you two must have been so cute running around on a barge.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: You never run on a barge!

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: (entering) Hey.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller & Phoebe Buffay: Hey.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Is ah, is Chandler around?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: No, umm, he met some girl at the coffee house.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Oooh.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Yeah, Ginger something.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Nooo. No, no, ah, are you sure it wasn't something that sounded like Ginger, like ah, Gingeer?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: No, it was Ginger. I remember, because when he told me, I said, (singing) 'the movie star.'

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Aww, man. That's the girl I was hiding from. When she finds out he's my roommate, she's gonna tell him what I did.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Well, what did you do?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: What, oh, oh, oh, no, no, I can't, I can't tell you that, it's like the most awful, horrible thing I've ever done my whole life.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Y'know what, don't tell us. We'll just wait until Chandler gets home, (to Phoebe) because it'll be more fun that way.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: All right!! Okay, it was like four years ago. Okay, Ginger and I had gone out a few times, and then this one weekend, we went up to her Dad's cabin. Just me, her, and her annoying little dog Pepper. Well that night, I cooked this really romantic dinner....

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: You gave her food poisoning!?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: I wish. No. After dinner, me, her, and Pepper all fell asleep in front of the fire. Well I woke up in the middle of the night and I saw that the fire was dying out. So, I picked up a log and threw it on. Or, at least what I thought was a log.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: Oh my God!! You threw Pepper on the fire!

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: I wish. See, I guess another thing I probably should've told you about Ginger is that she kinda has a ah, artificial leg.

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Oh my God! Joey, what did you do after you threw her leg on the fire?

Friends S03E14, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: I ran!!

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Well, that's the best kiss I've had with anyone I've ever met in a men's room.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Ginger: Actually, me too.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: (sees her foot is in a slush puddle) Op, foot in a puddle, foot all in a puddle.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Ginger: Oh damn, I hate that.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Yeah, we're gonna have to get you out of those shoes.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Ginger: Oh, don't worry about it.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: No, really you're gonna freeze.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Ginger: No, I'm not.

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: You're not, what do you, what do you got a bionic foot?

Friends S03E14, Scene 7
Ginger: Some day, maybe.

Friends S03E14, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Funny book?

Friends S03E14, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Hmmm. Oh, no, no, I just thinking about something funny I heard today. Umm, Mark, Mark saying 'I'll see you Saturday.'

Friends S03E14, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Yeah, at the lecture, I told you that last week, you said you didn't mind.

Friends S03E14, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Oh, no, no, no, it's-it's not the lecture ah, I mind, umm....

Rachel Green: Oh, God. Oh, God. (gets worried) Oh God.

Ross Geller: Ok, no, no, you hang up. You, you, y-(Rachel grabs the phone and hangs it up for him.)

Friends S04E21, Scene 20
Rachel Green: (on phone) Ross, hi, it's Rachel. I'm just calling to say that um, everything's fine and I'm really happy for you and your cat...(cut)...I am over you. I am over you and that, my friend, is what they call closure. (She hangs up and tosses phone in the ice bucket.)

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Ross Geller: Rach, I got a message from you.

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Rachel Green: Oh my God. Oh my God Ross, no, hang up the phone, give me the phone Ross, give me the phone, give me the phone, give me the. . . (She jumps the couch and lands on Ross's back, finally getting the phone from him. Ross has a confused expression on his face.)

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Ross Geller: You're over me?

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Rachel Green: Ohhhhhhhh God. (climbs off his back)

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Ross Geller: Wha... you're uh, you're, you're over me?

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Rachel Green: Ohh, ohh.

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Ross Geller: When, when were you... under me?

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Rachel Green: Well, basically, lately, I've uh, I've uh, sort of had feelings for you.

Friends S04E21, Scene 21
Ross Geller: OK, I need to lie down.

Friends S04E21, Scene 22
Joey Tribbiani: He broke up with Julie. Well, go hug her, for god's sakes.

Friends S04E21, Scene 22
Rachel Green: Really?

Friends S04E21, Scene 22
Ross Geller: Really. It's always been you, Rach.

Friends S04E21, Scene 22
Rachel Green: Oh, god.

Friends S04E21, Scene 22
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani: Ohhh.

Friends S04E21, Scene 23
Ross Geller: I've no idea, could be. Listen, I'm sorry I had to work tonight.

Friends S04E21, Scene 23
Rachel Green: Oh it's OK. You were worth the wait, and I don't just mean tonight.

Friends S04E21, Scene 23
Rachel Green: Ah, oh God. Oh, honey, oh that's OK.

Friends S04E21, Scene 23
Ross Geller: What. Oh no, you just rolled over the juice box.

Friends S04E21, Scene 24
Ross Geller: Gunther! Gunther. Gunther, please tell me you didn't say anything to Rachel about me and the girl from the Xerox place.

Friends S04E21, Scene 24
Gunther: I'm sorry. Was I not supposed to?

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Ross Geller: Y'know, hey! You're the one who ended it, remember?

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Rachel Green: Yeah, because I was mad at you, not because I stopped loving you!

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Ross Geller: You still love me?

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Rachel Green: Noo.

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Ross Geller: What does this mean? What do you, I mean do you wanna, get back together?

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Rachel Green: Noo! Maybe! I, I don't know.

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Ross Geller: What?!

Friends S04E21, Scene 25
Rachel Green: I just, I feel, I-I just...

Friends S04E21, Scene 26
Rachel Green: Y'know I can't believe I even thought about getting back together again! We are so over!!

Friends S04E21, Scene 26
Ross Geller: (starts to cry) FINE BY ME!! (he opens the door and traps Chandler behind it)

Friends S04E21, Scene 26
Rachel Green: And hey! Just so you know, it's not that common! It doesn't happen to every guy! And it is a big deal!!

Friends S04E21, Scene 26
Chandler Bing: I KNEW IT!!!!

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Judy Geller: Rachel's coming up the path. Doesn't she look pretty. Jack... (Rachel enters with a huge nose)

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Rachel Green: Oh my God.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: You know what this is, this is us getting ready for the prom.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Rachel Green: Oh.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Ross Geller: You know what, you guys, we don't have to watch this.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
#ALL#: Oh yeah we do. C'mon.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Judy Geller: Get a shot of Monica. Where's Monica.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Jack Geller: Wait, how do you zoom out? (zooms out and we see an extremely overweight Monica eating a big sandwich) There she is.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: Shut up, the camera adds ten pounds.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Chandler Bing: Ahh, so how many cameras are actually on you?

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: Oh, dad, turn it off.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Jack Geller: It is off. Right Ross? (pans over to see Ross with an afro and moustache)

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Joey Tribbiani: Lookin' good Mr. Cotter.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Rachel Green: I can't go to my own prom without a date, I can't, it's too late.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: If you're not going then I don't want to go either.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Judy Geller: (to Ross on the stairs) I have a wonderful idea. You should take Rachel to the prom.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Ross Geller: Y'know what? I think we've seen enough, let's turn it off.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
#ALL#: No, no, no.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Ross Geller: OK, fine, well I'm not gonna watch, alright.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Jack Geller: C'mon kid, let's go.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Judy Geller: Ahh, are you hadsome.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Jack Geller: Let's show 'em.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Ross Geller: (walks down the stairs and grabs the flowers out of the vase on the endtable) Okay dad.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Jack Geller: (going downstairs) Rachel, ready or not, here comes your knight in shining-Oh no. (Chip has shown up and the four are leaving.)

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Chip Matthews & Monica Geller & Rachel Green & Roy: Bye.

text:
Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Judy Geller: Oh, dear. Jack, how do I turn this off?

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: (to Ross) I can't believe you did that.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Ross Geller: Yeah, well.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Phoebe Buffay: See, he's her lobster.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: (seeing the decision) Nooooo. You're really not going?

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Rachel Green: Yeah. It's just gonna be too hard. Y'know? I mean, it's Ross. How can I watch him get married? Y'know it's just, it's for the best, y'know it is, it's... Y'know, plus, somebody's got to stay here with Phoebe! Y'know she's gonna be pretty big by then, and she needs someone to help her tie her shoes; drive her to the hospital in case she goes into labour.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Monica Geller: You don't have a car. And your license expired.

Friends S04E21, Scene 28
Rachel Green: I know. (Starts to cry) Yeah, see, there's so much to do and I have so little time to do it in.

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Chandler Bing: All right, check it out. Check this out. It says here that there's a place you can go to rent videos of all the museums! (Reading from the book.) "It's almost as good as being there."

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Joey Tribbiani: It's better! You can't go to a museum in your underwear!

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Chandler Bing: Well, You could, but... probably just the one time.

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Joey Tribbiani: I bet we could get videos of all the sites, get a VCR in our hotel room... we'd never even have to go outside!

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Chandler Bing: If we do that, we gotta get Die Hard.

Friends S04E21, Scene 29
Joey Tribbiani: Oh-ho! I bet the British version is gooooood!

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: (angrily) That's like the tenth time I've peed since I've been here!

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Monica Geller: That's also like the tenth time you told us.

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, oh I'm sorry, it must be really hard to hear! I tell ya, it's a lot easier having three babies play Bringing in the Noise, Bringing in da Funk on your bladder! I'm so sick of being pregnant! The only happiness I get is from a cup of coffee, which of course is decaf, 'cause-Oh! I'm pregnant!

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Pheebs, did...you want a cookie?

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: (starting to cry) Thank you so much.

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Rachel Green: So uh, Pheebs, honey, how are those mood swings coming?

Friends S04E22, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: I haven't really had any yet.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey guys!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Hey.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: All right, here's the ring. (Shows Chandler the wedding ring he plans on giving Emily)

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: (shocked) Yes! Yes! A thousand times, yes!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: So uh, any ideas for the bachelor party yet?

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Before you start handing out wedding rings and planning bachelor parties, don't you have to decide who your best man is gonna be?

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Oh, it's awkward. It's awkward. It's awkward.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: I sort've already asked Chandler.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: What?! He got to do it at your first wedding!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Joey, I figured you'd understand. I mean, I-I've known him a lot longer.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Come on Ross! Look, I-I don't have any brothers; I'll never get to be a best man!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: You can be the best man when I get married.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (pause) I'll never get to be a best man!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (to Chandler) Wait-wait, so, you get to be my best man twice and I never get to be yours at all?

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Oh no-no-no, you-yeah, of course you get to be my best man.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (impatiently tapping Chandler on the shoulder) What about me?! You-you just said I could!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I'm not even getting married! Okay, this is a question for science fiction writers!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I can't believe you're not picking me.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey, how can it not be me?!HeyHey!

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I'm not even... I'm not even...

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Fine, y'know what, that's it. From now on, Joey, I want you to be my best man.

Friends S04E22, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Yes! (to Chandler) Shame about you man.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: (to her babies) Stop it!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: What?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: One of the babies is kicking.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: I thought that was a good thing.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: It's not kicking me, it's kicking one of the other babies. Oh (looks down her dress)! Don't make me come in there!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: (entering) Hey!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Hey!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Do you guys have like a big bowl I can borrow?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Yeah, there's one right under the cabinet.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: (grabs it) Thanks.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Why do you need it?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, we're having a big party tomorrow night. Later! (Starts for the door.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Whoa! Hey-hey, you planning on inviting us?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Nooo, later. (Walks out the door.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Hey!! Get your ass back here, Tribbiani!! (Joey walks back in, scared.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Hormones!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: What Phoebe meant to say was umm, how come you're having a party and we're not invited?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, it's Ross's bachelor party.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Sooo?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Are you bachelors?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Nooo!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Are you strippers?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Nooo!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Then you're not invited. (Starts for the door again.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Rachel Green: All right fine! You're not invited to the party we're gonna have either.

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh-whoa, what party?

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Well umm...

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Monica Geller: The baby shower for Phoebe!

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Baby shower. Wow! That sounds sooo like something I don't want to do! Later! (Finally, he makes his exit.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: I can't believe I'm gonna have a party! This is so great! (Really excited) A party! (Really, really excited) Yay!! (Suddenly, she starts crying and Rachel moves to comfort her.) I don't know why.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: This is what I've got going for the party so far, liquor wise. Get a lot of liquor.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Great. Great.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Okay, now uh, in terms of the invite list, I've got you, me, and Chandler and I'm gonna invite Gunther 'cause, well, we've been talking about this pretty loud.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Gunther: I'll be there.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: All right-oh! Listen, I know this is your party, but I'd really like to the number of museum geeks that are gonna be there.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah. Tell ya what, let's not invite any of the anthropologists, only the dinosaur dudes!

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Okay! We'll need a six-pack of Zima.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: (entering) Hey guys, what are you doing?

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Oh, just planning my bachelor party with my best man.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Yeah, well, good luck trying to top the last one.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah, see, I don't think it's gonna that difficult considering this one won't be taking place in the basement of a Pizza Hut.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Oh, I'm Ross. I'm Ross. I'm too good for the Hut; I'm too good for the Hut.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Look, I gotta go pick up Ben. Everything so far sounds great Joey, just remember to keep it on the mellow side, okay? Just a couple of guys hanging out playing poker, no-no strippers or anything okay?

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: You got it.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Okay, see ya later.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: See ya. (Ross exits, and Chandler moves over next to Joey, laughing.) Have fun planning your mellow bachelor party.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Well, there's gonna be strippers there. He didn't say anything about no strippers.

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: He just said, "No strippers."

Friends S04E22, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, I chose not to hear that.

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Look what I got! Look what I got! Look what I got! (She shows Rachel what she bought. She bought a little leather jacket and a little cowboy outfit for the babies.) Can you believe they make these for little people?

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Little village people.

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Okay, look at this one. This is my favourite. (It's a little pink and white dress for the girl baby.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Oh, that is so sweet!

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: I know! Phoebe is gonna love dressing them in these!

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Huh. Except, Phoebe's not gonna be the one that gets to dress them.

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Because she's not gonna get to keep the babies.

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Oh my God! We are throwing the most depressing baby shower ever!

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Wait a minute! Unless, we give her all gifts she can use after she's done being pregnant. Like-like umm, regular coffee, Tequila.

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Oh, and somebody can get those leather pants she's always wanted!

Friends S04E22, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh, she's gonna love that!

Friends S04E22, Scene 6
Phoebe Buffay: What the hell is this?! What, did you actually thought it would make me feel better to give me stuff that I can't use for another two months?! This sucks! All right, what's my next present?!

Friends S04E22, Scene 6
#ALL#: I don't have anything. (All of the rest of the women there hide their gifts behind their backs.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Hey listen man, about the stripper...

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah?

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Good call!

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: (banging a spoon against his beer bottle) Okay, a little announcement, a little announcement. I've decided that my best man is, my best friend Gunther!

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Gunther: What's my last name?

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Central Perk?

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Gunther: (to Ross) Thanks for not marrying Rachel. (He starts to leave.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh-whoa-wait, Gunther don't-don't forget your shirt. (He gives Gunther his shirt and Gunther leaves.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Hey-hey, what are those?

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, little party favours, check it out! (It's a shirt that reads, "Ross Geller, Bachelor Bash 1998")

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Wow! Yeah!

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh-oh! (Shows him what's on the back, "Best Man Joey Tribbiani, with a huge picture of him.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: (banging on the bottle again) Okay, okay, a little announcement, I just want everyone to know that the position of my best man is still open! And uh, (to the stripper) so is the position of the bride.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
The Stripper: Great!

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Smooth man. Yeah, you got some chilie on your neck. (Chandler checks and runs into the bathroom.) Well, I just want to say, thanks everyone, this-this was great. And hey! See you guys Monday morning. (They museum geeks wave at him.) Thanks Joey.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, hey, don't forget your shirt.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Oh, thanks! (Takes it and throws it back into the box and leaves.)

Joey Tribbiani: Okay, hey, museum geeks, party's over. Okay. Wave bye-bye to the nice lady. There you go. Back to your parent's basement. All right. (The museum geeks exit and Joey unlocks his door and lets the chick and the duck out.) Come on boys, come on out! Here you go. All right.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah!

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
The Stripper: Wow, I didn't know they let you keep chickens and ducks as pets.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh yeah-yeah. And I got the duck totally trained. Watch this. Stare at the wall. (The duck complies.) Hardly move. (The duck complies.) Be white. (The duck complies.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
The Stripper: You are really good at that. So uh, I had fun tonight, you throw one hell of a party.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh thanks. Thanks. It was great meetin' ya. And listen if any of my friends gets married, or have a birthday, or a Tuesday...

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
The Stripper: Yeah, that would be great. So I guess umm, good night.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh unless you uh, you wanna hang around.

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
The Stripper: Yeah?

Friends S04E22, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah. I'll let you play with my duck.

Friends S04E22, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, (realises he doesn't know her name.) stripper! (He notices that the ring box is open, so he picks it up, sees it's empty and starts to panic.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: (running and banging on Chandler's door) The stripper stole the ring!! The stripper stole the ring!! Chandler! Chandler, get up! Get up! The stripper stole the ring!

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: (opening the door) What?

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: The ring is gone!

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Ugh. Just a sec, give me a minute to wake up for this-Ah-ha-ha!! You lost the ring! You're the worst best man ever!

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Dude, this isn't funny! What am I gonna do?! I go to bed last night, everything's cool! I wake up this morning, the stripper's gone and the ring is gone!

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: You slept with the stripper?

Friends S04E22, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Of course!! (Shrugs.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Hi, guys.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Hi! Phoebe. (Both Monica and her try to move out of Phoebe's way.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Hi Phoebe.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I-I wanted to apologise if I-y'know seemed a tad edgy yesterday at my shower. Y'know it's just the hormones, y'know.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: No we...

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Hormones.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: ...hormones, yeah.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you, it was just, it was so sweet. (She goes to hug them and they both flinch, thinking that Phoebe is about to attack them.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Wow, you seem to be doing so much better. That's great. So how-how are things going?

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Good. Y'know-no-no, okay, it's-it feels like everything's been about me lately, so what's happening with you?

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Oh, well, actually we were just talking about me not going to Ross's wedding.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Oh!

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: It just might be too hard, given the history and all that...

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Wow! This reminds me of the time when I was umm, living on the street and this guy offered to buy me food if I slept with him.

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: Well, h-how is this like that?

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Well, let's see, it's not. Really, like that. Because, you see that was an actual problem, and uh, yours is just like y'know a bunch of y'know high school crap that nobody really gives y'know...

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Rachel Green: (starting to cry) I'm-I'm sorry, I just thought that...

Friends S04E22, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Alrighty, here come the water works. (Rachel starts crying harder.)

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Ugh! I don't know what I'm going to do! I called the company that sent and th-they don't care! Then I called 9-1-1 and they laughed at me, if this isn't an emergency, then what is?

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Ross Geller: (entering) Hey guys!

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Hey!

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Hey...

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Ross Geller: I just wanted to thank you again for last night, what a great party! And the guys from work had a blast. Y'know, one of them had never been to a bachelor party before. Yeah! And-and another one had never been to a party before, so...

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: So uh, hey, that uh, that wedding ring, huh? Man, that's nice!

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Yeah, right!

Friends S04E22, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: I was uh, I was thinking I might want to pick one of those babies up for myself, I might want to get one of those...

Friends S04E22, Scene 11

Friends S04E22, Scene 11

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Why wouldn't ya? Erin is great! Then-then there's you guys.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Erin: Ohh, listen. I've got to get going. Today was great, thanks!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: I know!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Okay!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Erin: Bye Joey. (Kisses him.) Last night was fun.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah. I'll uh, I'll call ya.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Oh and I'll call ya too!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Erin: Or I'll call you!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: And call me!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: (to Erin) Okay, good to see you again.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Erin: Bye.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Bye-bye.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Bye!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: So, system kinda broke down huh?!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Oh Joey, I'm sorry I just couldn't tell her all those things you wanted me to tell her. And y'know we got to talking and I...

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: We want you to marry her!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: What?!!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: She is so amazing! You have no idea.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: No idea? Who do you think brought her here?

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Cupid.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Joey, she's so cool. She speaks four languages.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Man, do you know what guys want!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Look Joey, come on she's so perfect for you! I mean she's sweet, she-she likes baseball, and she-she had two beers at lunch.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: My beers?! Look you guys, she's a very nice girl. Okay? We had a good time, but I just-I don't see it going anywhere.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, but you always say that.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Yeah, maybe if you gave this girl a chance it would go somewhere.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Look I'm sorry you guys, I-I just don't think so.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Whatever.

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Fine. (They start to walk away.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, don't start judging me! (To Rachel) Huh? You're the one who's in love with her assistant! (To Phoebe) Huh? And you, you're the one having the affair with the guy who keeps the pigeons on the roof!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Phoebe!

Friends S07E07, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Secret affair!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: People are doing it in front of my book!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: I'm sorry?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: My doctoral dissertation is in the library at school, I went to see it, and there were students makin' babies right in the middle of the Paleontology section!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Oh my God! Did you get to see anything good?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Let me ask you something, at your school was there a like uh a place on campus where students went to uh, fool around.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Yeah, there was. It was-there the corner of the library where-where all these dusty books that nobody ever read-Yes, there was.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Great! Because people kept showing up, I think it's like uh-a thing!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Now hold on a second, fifth floor against that back wall?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Ross Geller: Oh for cryin' out loud! (He storms out.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: All right, so we should go catch our movie.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Well now what's the rush?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: I like to see the previews. (Rachel looks at him.) The candy.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: (entering with Erin) Oh. Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Well look who's here!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Erin: Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Erin: Joey.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Erin.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Erin: Hey Rachel.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Hi! Well, we were just about to take off and see a movie. Oh no!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Erin: What's wrong?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: Oh Phoebe, we forgot that party we have to go to.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: Oh no.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: (skeptical) What party?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: A birthday party.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: Who's birthday party?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: Allison's birthday party.

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: (still skeptical) Oh, and how is Allison?

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: 32. (Joey's not buying it.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Rachel Green: (does a retching sound) Wait a minute! Why don't you guys do something?!

Friends S07E07, Scene 5
Joey Tribbiani: (still skeptical) Yeah, look how that worked out.

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Excuse me. Hi, I'm a professor here. Do you know the Paleontology section, fifth floor, stack 437?

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
The Librarian: Well, yes! Just give me five minutes, I just have to find someone to cover my shift.

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
Ross Geller: No! No!! No! Can I speak to someone in charge please?! (The librarian brings his boss over.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
The Head Librarian: How can I help you?

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Hi, I was wondering if it is possible to increase security in the Paleontology section? See I-I wrote a book up there and instead of reading it people are-are-are well, rolling around in front of it.

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
The Head Librarian: We are aware of the problem you are referring too. (He turns to look at the previous librarian.) But as far as increasing security, I'm afraid the library is very understaffed. I, I can't help you.

Friends S07E07, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Well, fine. Fine! If-if I'm the only person with any appreciation of the sanctity of the written word, I'll go up there and defend it myself! (Starts to do so, but stops and to the previous librarian) And don't you follow me!

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Hey.

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Rachel Green: How did it go with Erin?

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, unbelievable! We had the best time!

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Yay!! Oh so, you're not, you're not mad at us anymore?

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: No! No! No! You guys were totally right! This is so much better than the first time we went out. Y'know? That was so awkward, we were really nervous.

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Didn't you sleep together?

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah that really calms me down. And! We have so much in common! She loves sandwiches, sports, although she is a Met fan, not much of an issue now but if were ever to have kids, well that's a...

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Rachel Green: (gasps) Oh my God! Listen to you talkin' about having kids. Oh my Joey. (She goes over and hugs him.) Oh, please don't get married before I do.

Friends S07E07, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Okay.

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Janice Litman Goralnik: Oh. Oh I just cannot believe Clark stood me up!

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: He might still show up.

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Janice Litman Goralnik: Oh, what are you, stupid? It's been three hours.

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Is that all?

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Janice Litman Goralnik: I should just go on to happier things, okay? Umm, why don't you tell about your lovely wedding?

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Well actually uh, there was something we wanted to tell you about the wedding. Um, it's going to be a small ceremony. Uh, tiny! We're not even sure why we're having it.

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Monica Geller: It's actually going to be just family.

Friends S07E07, Scene 8
Janice Litman Goralnik: Oh...wait...you two think of me as family?! Oh, I have to ask you something now and be honest; do you want me to sing Careless Whisper or Lady In Red?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: How can you say that?! The Mets have no closer!

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: What about Benitez?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: What about Game 1 of the Series?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: What about shut up?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: You shut up! (To Phoebe and Rachel) I love arguing with her. (To Erin) I'll be right back.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Okay. (Joey goes to get some coffee and Erin sits down.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: So how's it goin' with Joey?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Uh, okay.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Okay? Wait okay, tell-tell me that you like him, please? I mean tell me that you like him.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Look, he's a really great guy and I know that you really want this to work out, but I just don't see this having a future.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: But you said that you liked him! I mean what happened?! Did ya just change your mind?!

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Kinda.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Then change it back!

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: I'm sorry I... It's just there's no real spark.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: No spark? Didn't you sleep together?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Yeah.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Ugh, tramp!

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Does Joey have any idea?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: I really don't think he does. And y'know what? Maybe you guys could help clue him in. Y'know, tell him I'm-I'm not interested in a serious relationship or something.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, you mean like that you're kind of a loner.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Yeah! That would be great!

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, and maybe that you're a real (She says something in Italian, and it doesn't matter what she said. It's not important so I don't need everyone who speaks Italian telling me what she said.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: I'm sorry?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Oh well, I guess Italian isn't one of the four languages you speak.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: (returning) Hey! You wanna go?

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Yeah, let's go.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Okay. See you guys later.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Erin: Bye guys.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Yeah, see ya.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: (whispers to Phoebe and Rachel) Hey, thank you so much. (They both exit.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Wow. Well, I guess it was Cupid who brought her here.

Friends S07E07, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: No, just a regular old flying dwarf.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Yes? Yes?! How can I help you?

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Guy: Yeah, we were...we were just looking around.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Oh-oh, you're-you're fellow scholars. What exactly were you looking for, hmm? Perhaps, (Grabs a book from the shelf behind him) perhaps Dr. Chester Stock's musings on the Smiledon Californicus?

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Guy: Uhh....

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Ah... Ah...Get out of here! (The couple retreats. Ross starts looking through the previously mentioned book as a beautiful woman walks into the section.) Uh, meeting someone? Or-or are you just here to brush up on Marion's views on evolution?

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Woman: Uh, actually I find Marion's views far to progressionist.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: I find Marion's views far to progressionist.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Woman: I'm sorry, who are you?

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: I'm a professor here uh, Ross...Geller.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Woman: Ross Geller, why do I know that name? It's uh-Wait! (Grabs his book off of the shelf.) Did you write this?

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Yes! You're the person who checked out my book?!

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Woman: Y'know, you look nothing like I would've thought. You're...you're so young.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Well I uh, I skipped forth grade.

Friends S07E07, Scene 10
Ross Geller: I am very...very sorry.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Hey!

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: So how was, how was your date?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, it was great! I mean we walked all around the village. We went to this ice cream place, split a milkshake, 70/30 but still... And guess what, I'm thinking about taking her upstate to one of those bed and breakfasts.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Oh really? She said she wants to go away with you?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: No-no-no-no-no! It's a surprise, but it's gonna be tricky thought because she said she was gonna be pretty busy at work for a while.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: Oh no, yeah.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Jo-Joey, look honey we-we need to talk okay? Umm, I kinda got the feeling from her today that uh, she's not lookin' for a serious relationship.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Where are you gettin' this?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Well, she told me. She said she's kinda a loner.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Oh. Oh.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Joey...

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: No hey Rach, it's cool okay? Y'know I'm a loner too! (Heads for his room.) Right?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Hey Joey, y'know what? You are way to good for her.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Yeah and honey I promise next time that I will just say good-bye and tell 'em you're not looking for a relationship.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: No! No. Don't do that, just next time make sure she really likes me.

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Well that too. (Joey goes into his room.) Joey?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Do you want some pancakes?

Friends S07E07, Scene 11
Joey Tribbiani: (coming back out) Finally!

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: What are we gonna do?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: I say we go with Careless Whisper.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Chandler?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: (To Monica) Did she see us yet? Did she see us?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Janice, what umm, what are you doing here?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Well umm, I thought I was going to go back to my apartment but then I just felt I couldn't really be alone tonight. (Joey walks into view of the open door behind Janice, sees her, gets a terrified look on his face, and flees in horror.) I was wondering if I could maybe stay here with you, just I really feel that I need to be with family.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: (To Chandler) Our kids are gonna call her Aunt Janice aren't they?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Please, it's because otherwise I really don't know what I might do.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Aren't you just a tinsy bit curious?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: (starting to cry) Do you have any tissues?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Yeah, in-in-in the bathroom.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Okay! (She runs for the bathroom)

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: We'll just...we'll just let her stay.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: No-no-no-no, if we let her stay, she will stay forever!

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Kinda like your Barca lounger.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Is that what you're thinking about right now?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: I never stop thinking about it.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Hey you guys, umm do either one of you want to get in there before I take my bath.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Janice, I'm sorry but umm, you can't stay here tonight.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Why not?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Honestly? Our apartment is a hotbed for electromagnetic activity. Now Monica and I have been immunized, but sadly you have not.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Okay, I'm going to need a comforter, but did you have a hypoallergenic one because otherwise I get very nasal. (Makes some weird sound) Do you have a cat? 'Cause it's already happening. (Makes a nasal sound) Do you hear that? (She keeps making the nasal sound.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Oh my God! Oh my God! You have to go!

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Why?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Because Chandler still has feelings for you!

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: He does?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Say again?

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: That's right. That's right. And that is why you can't stay here tonight. And probably why you shouldn't come to the wedding.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Feelings, such strong feelings.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Monica Geller: I mean, I realize that his feelings may never completely go away, but you can.

Friends S07E07, Scene 12
Janice Litman Goralnik: Oh...my Gawd, I-I understand. I-I am so sorry, I'll go. (Starts for the door.) Good-bye Monica (hugs her), I wish you a lifetime of happiness with him. Chandler, (hugs him) you call me when this goes in the pooper. (Hurries out.)

Friends S07E07, Scene 13
Ross Geller: (to the guard) Don't sweat it, I've got this section covered. Yeah, in fact I've got this little baby (Turns on a mini-flashlight) to shine in people's eye-(The guard walks away)-Okay, see you later.

Friends S07E07, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: I just wanted to show Monica your book. (Ross just glares at him.)

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Ross Geller: (entering) Hey everybody! Happy Thanksgiving!

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No, no, no. No-no-no.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani & Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: Shhhh!

metadata.speaker: Joey Tribbiani & Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green

text:
Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Ross Geller: What, are we keeping Thanksgiving a secret this year?

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No, we're playing this game I learned at work. You have to name all the states in six minutes.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Ross Geller: What? That's like insanely easy!

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Now, that's a lot harder than it sounds. You always forget at least one, or in some cases... fourteen (looks over to Monica).

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Monica Geller: It's a stupid game and I wasn't playing against other people, so technically I didn't lose.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Ross Geller: What? You forgot fourteen states?

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Nobody cares about the Dakotas. (That's true in so many ways, trust me, I've lived in one and been to the other.)

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Oh, okay, time's up!

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Rachel Green: All right, I got 48.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Oh that's not bad, Pheebs?

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, I Got Tired Of Naming States. So I Decided To List The Types Of Celery, And I Have One regular celery.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Okay, so Rachel's got 48 and Phoebe has the lead in...vegetables, Joey?

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani: Say hello to the new champ of Chandler's dumb states game.

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Wow, how many have you got?

Friends S07E08, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani: Fifty-six!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey! How is New England not a state? Huh? They have a sports-team!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Does South Oregon have a sports-team? (Joey strikes one from his list) There you go.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (counting the place settings) How come we have one extra place setting?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: 'Cause you invited your assistant.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh, right. Sorry. But Tag's not coming; his girlfriend came into town, so he's spending Thanksgiving with her.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Oh! Why didn't you tell me? I made him his own individual sweet potato stuffed pumpkin.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well, I was going to, but then I figured, you know... you're food is so delicious and perfect, you can never have too many of those pumpkin things.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Now you think I wouldn't enjoy that, because it is so fake, (Laughs) but I still do.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Regular Celery! (Starts to write that on her list) Oh, I already have that. (She gets up and heads for her room)

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Done! With time a-to-spare.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Oooh that may be a New World's record (Looks at his watch and picks up Ross' pad)

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: You know, I hate to lecture you guys, but it's kinda disgraceful, that a group of well-educated adults and Joey can't name all the states. Did you ever see a map, or one of those round, colorful things called "a globe?" Hmm?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Uh, Magellan? You got 46 states. (Smiles and hands Ross back his pad)

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: What? That's impossible.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: 46. Wow! Who's well educated now, Mr. I-forgot-ten-states?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: All right, I'm out of oven space. I'm gonna turn on Joey's. Please, watch him! Do not let Joey eat any of the food!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I am only one man! (Monica heads out) Okay Ross, time is up!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: No, just give me another minute.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Look Ross, if you don't know them by now, you will never know them, okay? That is the beauty of this game. It makes you want to kill yourself.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: This-this is crazy! I can do this! All right, uhh, I bet I can get all 50 before dinner.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Okay, but if you can't...no dinner!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: You're on!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (gets up) All right. Don't look at my list, Ross, 'cause there's a lot on there that you don't have.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: (entering, to Joey and Rachel) Hey, did you guys know, that your oven doesn't work?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: But the drawer full of take-out menus is okay, right?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Ross, I'm gonna use yours, okay?

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Pshhshhh!

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Chandler? Can you give me a hand? (Grabs her jacket)

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Sure, and Joey; do not let Ross look at any of the maps or the globe in your apartment.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Don't worry, Chandler, it's not a globe of the United States.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Hey you guys I'm gonna go out and take a walk.

Friends S07E08, Scene 2
