Rachel Green: Well, why shouldn't I be? I have great friends! I have a wonderful job!

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Where you can make out with your assistant.

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Come on, it's not a big deal! We stayed up all night coming up with a plan so that us dating will not be a problem.

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Oh yeah, what's the plan?

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (pauses as she thinks and exhales loudly) We... We are not... ...going to let it... be a problem.

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Wow! It took you all night to come up with that plan?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well y'know, we did other stuff too. (Joey and Chandler start to giggle.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Did you two...

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh Monica come on, y'know I don't sleep with guys on the first date!

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Matt Guire, Mark Lynn, Ben Wire...

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Anymore!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Okay.

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Hi. Tag, I have a conference call today is that correct?

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Tag Jones: Yes, at 4:00.

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Okay, thank you. That'll be all. (The mail guy leaves and Tag starts to follow, but Rachel stops him.) (Excitedly) Wait! Wait! (Rushes over and closes the office-door.) Did you see that? That mail guy had no idea there was something going on between us. (They kiss.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Tag Jones: I'd better get back to my desk.

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Okay, you hard worker! I'll remember to put that in your evaluation.

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Tag Jones: My what?

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Well, you've been here for two months now and your boss is required to hand in a performance evaluation. But y'know, there is one thing that I have yet to evaluate. (She turns around and sweeps the stuff off of her desk and hops up onto it.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Tag Jones: Are you serious?

Friends S07E09, Scene 3
Rachel Green: No, I've just always wanted to do that. Can you help me clean this up?

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: The basket is totally empty! My God, the neighbors ate all the candy!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Well, either that or uh...(Motions towards Joey's door.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Joey!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah?

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Did you eat all the neighbor candy?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Uh well yeah, that was the plan, but by the time I got to it there was only a couple of pieces left!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, and they've been coming by all day. They love it!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: They love my candy? Oh man!!! I've gotta go make more!! (Starts to do so.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Mon, you might wanna make some more lasagna too, because something might've happened to a huge chunk of it.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Ross! The neighbors ate all my candy!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Mine stole my newspaper! It's like a crime wave!! (Monica runs to make more candy.) Pheebs, you uh, you got a second.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Sure!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah, ever since you uh, told me that story about that bike I-I couldn't stop thinking about it. I mean, everyone should have a-a first bike, so...

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: (gasps) Oh my God Ross!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: You like it?

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I love it!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah?

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Ohh!! Ohh!! And I love you!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Ahh.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Not that way! But the bike brought you a lot closer!

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Ah! (She hugs him.) Well uh-uh, t-take it downstairs, y'know give it a test ride.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Okay! Oh my God! My first bike! Thank you for the best present I've ever gotten.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Ross Geller: (stunned at the complement) You're welcome.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: (starts to leave, but stops) Oh and Chandler's about to cry.

Friends S07E09, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: (about to cry) Am not!

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Monica Geller: (turning a light on) Who is that?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Don't worry, I'm brave! I am brave! I...I am brave! (They get to the door and Monica goes to open it.) No-no-no-no!! (He stops her.) (Through the door.) Can you tell me who is there please?

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
The Knocker: My name is Gary, I live upstairs.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Gary: Hi!

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Hi. Do you know what time it is?

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Gary: It's candy time! My roommate says that they taste like little drops of heaven.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh please! (To Chandler) Did you hear that? Little drops of heaven.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: (laughs) 4:00 A.M.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Gary: So, can I get some candy?

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: I am sorry, but some of us have to get up early and go to work! (Monica looks at him) (To Monica) He does not know that I am not some of us.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Umm, listen I am sorry, but I'll put some out first thing in the morning.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Gary: Well okay, I'll swing by later. Do you live in this building?

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Um-hmm.

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Gary: (looking at Monica.) Mm! Seems like I would've remembered you!

Friends S07E09, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Mm! Night Gar'! (Monica closes the door.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Rachel Green: (hugging him) So did you read your evaluation yet?

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Tag Jones: No! It was marked confidential I just sent it down to Human Resources.

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Rachel Green: (worried) Okay please, you're kidding right?! I wrote that one as a joke for you!

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Tag Jones: A joke they would appreciate?

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Rachel Green: I'm thinkin' no.

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Tag Jones: What did you say?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Rachel Green: Umm, I said I thought you were a good kisser, and uh, and that I like your tiney-tiny touchie.

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Tag Jones: No, not my touchie.

Friends S07E09, Scene 6
Rachel Green: Well, it gets worse. When asked if you take initiative I wrote, "Yes, he was able to unhook my bra with minimal supervision," and under Problems with Performance I wrote, "Dear God, I hope not," and then uh, then I drew a little smiley face, and then a small pornographic sketch.

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Monica Geller: Ross! That is so sweet of you to get Phoebe that bike! When I heard the story, I almost cried.

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Almost cried huh? Hear that Chandler? Almost cried!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Hey, you cry every time somebody talks about Titanic!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: (about to cry) Those two only had each other!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Phoebe really likes the bike huh?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Monica Geller: Oh yeah! I saw her walkin' it down the street the other day. She had uh, these flowers in the basket. It was so cute.

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, I saw her this morning walkin' it by the park.

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Wait a minute, she was walking the bike? Both times?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Pheebs?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Oh hi!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Hey! So are you enjoying the bike?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Ohh, uh-huh so much!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Pheebs you uh...you do know how to ride a bike don't you?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Of course!

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Monica Geller: Umm, can we see you ride it?

Friends S07E09, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Okay. (The gang is giggles then Phoebe gets the bike out of the rack, gets on, pushes off, rolls a few feet, and falls over.) See?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: See, this is why I told you never get involved with your assistant! And here is no such thing as keeping secrets when it comes to affairs. (To Chandler) Did you hear that Chandler? No such thing!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (with his mouth full) What happened? I'm just eating candy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Maybe it's not as bad as I think. Y'know, maybe they didn't take it the way I meant it.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Absolutely! Y'know, because touchie can mean both ass and good worker.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Ugh, I just gotta get the thing back!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Rach?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Yeah?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: That sketch you mentioned? Might it have looked a little something like this? (He shows her what he's been drawing.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh my God! Joey!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: What is the matter with you?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Ugh!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Boy I tell ya, this little talent came in handy before I could afford porn.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: Hi! I'm sorry, I know it's after hours but I really need candy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: I'm sorry, I can't help you. See? (Points to her new sign.) Rules are rules.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: Please! I have people coming from out of town today! And, I told them all about your candy!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: No kidding, out of towners huh? What did you tell 'em?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: I told 'em your candy is absolutely indescribable!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Some people have been saying its y'know little drops of heaven, but whatever.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: Please, can't you help me out?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (watching the discussion) Hey Chandler, do we know that lady?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Maybe, isn't she the woman who lives below you and has sex really loud?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (still talking to the woman) All right, I'll do it just this once! But you can't tell anybody!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: (exasperatedly) Yes! Yes! Please, just give it to me!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller: Yeah, that's her.

metadata.speaker: Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller

text:
Friends S07E09, Scene 8
The Woman: (after Monica gives her the candy) Thank you.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (closing the door) It's unbelievable! I-I can't believe that sign didn't work!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Y'know what would work?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Hmm?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Stop making candy!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: But they like it!

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: You mean they like you.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Maybe.

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Is that why you became a chef? So that people would like you?

Friends S07E09, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh, you really want to talk about getting people to like you huh, funny man? (Joey laughs but stops when Chandler turns to glare at him.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Okay, now just remember everything I taught you and you'll be fine. Okay? Here we go. Ready...Set...

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: (hopping off the bike) Wait! This seat is really uncomfortable! Yeah, maybe before we start we should just get another one. Perhaps, like an airplane seat-or a beanbag chair!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Phoebe, you can't get out of this! Okay? You have to learn how to ride a bike!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Why? Why do I have to learn?

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Well...In-in case of emergency.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: What kind of an emergency?

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Well let there-what if a man comes along and puts a gun to your head and says, "You ride this bike or I'll sh...I'll shoot you."

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, I would ring the bell to distract him and then I would knock the gun out of his hand with a Chinese throwing star.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Okay, Phoebe just-just get-get on the bike and-Hey! I'll hold you up and-and push you. Okay?

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: You won't let go?

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: No!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Swear?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: I swear!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: (thinks it over) Okay.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Come on. (She gets on the bike.) All right, here we go. All right? (They start.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: All right.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: All right. Feel good?

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Well...

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: All right, try pedaling.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Okay. (Does so.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: That's it, your doing great.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Okay.

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Doing great! Yes-yes-yes! Take control! Yes!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Weee!!! (Ross pushes her and lets go.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Yes!! Yes!!! (He starts clapping and Phoebe turns around to look at him and falls off the bike.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Oh! Oh! Oh no!! You swore!

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: I-I just thought you were doing so well. I...

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: I am shocked! Shocked!! (She storms off leaving Ross to defend himself from the angry looks from onlookers.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 9
Ross Geller: It's a legitimate learning technique. (Looking around and seeing the woman behind him glaring at him.) Wow!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Hey, there's uh, some people outside, askin' about candy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Well, they're just gonna have to wait aren't they? I've only got two hands!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Need some help?

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Monica Geller: No! You don't know the system! There'll be nobody messing with the system!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: By the way, the week before your wedding you may not see a lot of me. (She glares at him and he quickly makes his way to Phoebe's room.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: (seeing him) Oh, hello liar.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: (entering) Look, I-I'm really sorry I let go of the bike.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I could've been killed I hope you know!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: I know. I know. But, can we please try it again? Huh? I mean, you were so close Phoebe!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Well, I would love to but...the bike got stolen and the police have no suspects. (Ross just happens to have his hand on a sheet that is covering something that suspiciously looks like a bike.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Phoebe.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: What?! (Ross rings the bell.) What the hell?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: All right, y'know what? If you are not going to learn how to ride this bike then I'm sorry, I'm just gonna have to take it back.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: What?! Why?!

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Because! Because, it-it-it's... It'd be like you having this guitar (Points to hers) and-and never playing it. Okay, this guitar wants to be played! And-and this bike wants to be ridden and-and if you don't ride it you-you're-you're killing its spirit! (Pause) The bike is dying.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: All right. If you care enough to make up that load of crap, okay.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Great! Great! (He runs to the door.) You're making the bike very happy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: (sarcastically) Okay Ross! (Ross exits and she says quietly to the bike) Please don't die!

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Okay, I think we can get the evaluation back before they see it, but we're gonna have to get into Mr. Zelner's office. Now, he doesn't get in until 10, so he's no problem, but his assistant, Betty, she comes in early to eat her breakfast at her desk.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: That's kinda sad.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Yeah, well Betty's kinda sad. Which is why I believe I can lure her away with these chocolates. (Holding up the box of chocolates.) Now, while I distract her, you get in the office.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: Got it!

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Let's roll!

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: Hello Rachel, you uh, got a minute?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: (worried and shocked) Yeah, sure Mr. Zelner, for you anything-minute. Okay. Fine. (To Tag) Abort the plan, abort the plan. (She start to usher Tag out.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: Uh actually, I'd like to speak with both of you.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Okay. Uh, well can we, can we get you anything Mr. Zelner? Maybe some chocolates? (Holds up the box.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: Umm, no. Thanks, but I'll give these to Betty. (Rachel glances at Tag to say, "See?") So I read your evaluation of Tag, or to use his full name, Tag Sweetcheeks Jones. Is something going on with you two?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: (laughs) Oh my God. Can you imagine if there was?! I mean, (getting serious) what would happen exactly.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: Well, I'd be forced to file a report. I'd have to consult with the legal department, and your future at the company would be in jeopardy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Well...

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: (interrupting) Uh Mr. Zelner, I'm the one who filled in that evaluation.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Oh no-no-no...

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: (interrupting again) Yeah-yeah-yeah-yeah-yeah, I thought it would be funny.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: You wrote that you have a cute touchie?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: (pause) Yes. I have a weird sense of humor, and I'm kinda strangely proud of my butt.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: It's kind of a risky joke Tag, and what is-what is this drawing I can't figure out what this is?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: You're lookin' at it upside down-y'know what? (Grabs the evaluation and throws it out.) It doesn't matter.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Mr. Zelner: Yeah, it's not like I don't have a sense of humor, huh? Hell, I even enjoy a naughty limerick now and then. But there's a time and a place, huh?! Unless you uh, have a limerick right now? (They both nod no.) No? Okay, well uh, you've (Grabs the chocolates.) got my fax number. (Exits.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Whoa! I can't believe you did that. That was really sweet.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: No, don't worry about it.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: No, you could've lost your job.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: Are you kidding me?! With a cute butt like this, I'd find work.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: Thank you! You're great! (They kiss.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: Y'know what?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: What?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: I feel great. (Rachel laughs) In fact! (Walks over to her desk, sweeps its contents onto the floor and Rachel just glares at him.) What?

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: I... It just-it took me so long to get that desk organized.

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Tag Jones: Oh, I'm sorry. (He bends over to pick the stuff up.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 11
Rachel Green: (looking at his butt) There it is. (They hug.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: (asking a man leaning against the wall) What is going on?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
The Man: We're waiting for the candy. (Yelling at the door.) Bring out the candy!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah lady! Give us candy!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Joey!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: What's up buddy?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: What are you doing?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Waiting for candy.

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Get in here! (They head for the door and Chandler sees Smokes-A-Lot Lady standing next to the door and smoking, to her) Hey, and you can not smoke in here! (Takes the cigarette and takes a drag for himself.) (Exhaling in ecstasy) Merry Christmas.

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Monica Geller: (opening the door and frantically) Okay, guys! The candy is coming; I just need another 15 minutes for the chocolate to cool!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
#ALL#: We want candy! We want candy now! (And other general commotion sounds.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: All right everybody! Just be quiet! Be quiet! Be quiet!! Pipe-pipe-pipe down! (They settle down) What is the matter with you people?! This woman was trying to do a nice thing for you. She was making candy so she could try to get to know all of you, and I'll bet that not one of you can tell me her name! Am I right?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
The Man: (from earlier) Candy Lady?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: No not (imitating) Candy Lady.

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: (stepping in and knocking the man over) Hey, if we know it can we have candy?!!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: All right, y'know what? Forget it, all of you forget it! You've ruined it! Go home! You've ruined it! You've ruined it!

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: That's right, it's all ruined! You guys ruined everything! You ruined it! (Steps into the apartment and Chandler closes the door.) (Joey struts over to the candy and starts eating it.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Monica Geller: (To Chandler) Thank you.

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: You're welcome. (They kiss.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Did you smoke?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: No! Smokes-A-Lot Lady blew smoke directly into my mouth. Eh-uh-are you okay?

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Monica Geller: I'm fine now, but it was really scary there for a while. I mean, someone slipped a-a threatening note under the door.

Friends S07E09, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: (with his mouth full) Oh yeah, sorry about that. Mob mentality or whatever, I don't know... (Grabs the note.)

Friends S07E09, Scene 13
Phoebe Buffay: I can't believe it! I did it! I rode a bike! I never thought I'd be able to do that! Thank you Ross.

Friends S07E09, Scene 13
Ross Geller: Oh hey, don't thank me, thank yourself. You're the one who faced her fears and ultimately overcame them.

Friends S07E09, Scene 13
Phoebe Buffay: Don't be so corny Ross, it's not an after-school special. (She rides off and the camera pans down to reveal two shiny, silver training wheels firmly attached.)

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Buh-bye. (Hangs up the phone) I just got us reservations at Michelle's and tickets to the Musicman to celebrate our first holiday season as a betroughed couple.

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Betrothed... (Corrects him)

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: ...betrothed couple.

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: (entering carrying a skull) Hey!

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Hey!

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Monica Geller & Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Haaaa... (Puts the skull on the table) ... ahhhh!

Friends S07E10, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Pheebs?

Joey Tribbiani: Sure. (Chandler is staring at Molly)

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Would you stop staring at her?

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: I wasn't staring. I was leering.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Monica Geller: What's the big deal with her? Maybe she's attractive in an obvious kind of way.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Yeah, obvious beauty's the worst. You know, when it's right there in your face. Me, I like to have to work to find someone attractive. Makes me feel like I earned it.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Looks like Joey is doing allright with her.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Yeah. Hey, that was nice of you guys to back off and let Joey get the girl for once.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Molly: (to Ross) I'm gonna take her back to the appartment.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Ok, I'll be home right after work. Ok, by Emma-Wemma-Demma, I love you - wovyou dovyou ...

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Molly: Bye.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Monica Geller: They've elected me to talk to you about the baby talk - it's not so good.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Molly: I think it's sweet. (goes to leave)

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller: Bye, Emma-Wemma-Demma.

text:
Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Rachel Green: (to Joey) Hey, listen, Joey, about Molly, I really prefer if you didn't go after her.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Why not?

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Because it took us months to find a good nanny and I wouldn't want anything to, you know, drive her away.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: So, what, you think I'm just gonna sleep with her and never call her again and things are gonna get uncomfortable? (thinks about it) Yeah, sounds about right.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Come on, there are plenty of other women out thereok? Just - just forget about her, ok? Just, she's off limits.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, man, why did have to go and say that for? Now that you told me I can't have it makes me want her even more!

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: What are you, a child?

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yes!

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Joey, come on now, for me! Please, just-just try to focus your sexual energy on someone else.

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Fine. (looks around, then focuses on Monica)

Friends S09E12, Scene 4
Monica Geller: (to Chandler) Take me home! (they quickly leave)

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: Hey Mikey.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: Hey P.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: What are you doing?

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: Setting rat traps.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: To kill Bob??

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: No, no, to test his neck strength.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: No, Mike, I don't want to kill him! I thought we were just gonna capture him and, and you know, set him free in the country side where he can maybe meet a friendly possom and a wisecracking owl.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: Ok, ok, I'll throw away the traps.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: I'll find Bob, I'll get him. Bob? (starts looking) Bob! Robert! (looks at cabinet under sink) Oh wait, I think I hear him. Oh - Oh my god! Bob had babies! Bob's a mom!

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: Better think of a new name for him.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: I don't know, I kinda like Bob for a girl.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: I don't know, I mean I'm not sure (they hear cracking voice from somewhere else in the kitchen, probably a rat caught in a trap) ...

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: Oh my god, we killed Bob!

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Mike Hannigan: Maybe it wasn't Bob, maybe it was a mouse.

Friends S09E12, Scene 5
Phoebe Buffay: Suzie? (Runs over there to check)

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Whazzup??

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Seriously dude, 3 years ago.

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Listen, can you do me a favor? I'm gonna be out today. Can you just keep an eye on Joey, make sure nothing happens between him and Molly?

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: You don't trust him?

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Wh - No. Some woman who sounded a lot like Joey called earlier and asked for her daughter, the "hot nanny".

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Is this really your long term plan, for me to run interference? Because I could get a job any day now.

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: You do appear right on the cusp of something. Come on man, I'm sure he'll lose interest in a week or two, but for now can you please just do this for me?

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Allright, fine, but don't blame me if it doesn't work. Because you know as well as I do that once Joey sets his mind on something, more often than not, he's going to have sex with it.

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: Well we gotta do something, ok? Nannies like her don't grow on trees. (pause)

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Picturing that tree?

Friends S09E12, Scene 6
Ross Geller: I am, yes.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Where you going, Joe? (Joey falls on floor and gets up)

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: For a walk.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Oh. You mind if I join you?

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Actually, that will be long. You know, I really need to organize my thoughts.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Your thoughts? Plural?

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Allright, fine, I only have one thought! It's about the hot nanny, I gotta see her!

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: I'm afraid I can't let you do that, Joe.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Now YOU'RE telling me I can't see her?? You guys are killing me! She's forbidden fruit! It's like ... like she's the princess and I'm the stable boy ... Why are you doing this, huh? Did Ross tell you not to let me go over there?

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Yes, as a matter of fact he did, so I can't let you go.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Huh. Interesting. Now there are obstacles. Hot nanny and me against the world. This is the kind of stuff great novels are made of.

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Chandler Bing: Great novels?

Friends S09E12, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Fine ... mediocre porn.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Gavin Mitchelle's office.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Rachel Green's office!! Give me that phone! (takes the phone) Hello, this is Rachel Green, how can I help you? Uh huh ... ok then ... I'll pass you back to your son (gives phone to Gavin)

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Hey Mom! No, that's just my secretary. (Rachel is upset)

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Um, excuse me Gavin, I have a question I need to ask you.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Mom, I'll call you later. Yeah. (hangs up) (to Rachel) Yes?

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: If you like looking at butts so much why don't you just go look at a mirror?

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Thank god you finally said that, I saw you make a note on your pad three hours ago. (Rachel throws away that paper) Man, I really bug you, don't I?

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, please, I don't care about you enough to bug me. In fact, from now on, I'm going take the high road. And I'm going be very very nice to you, you "momma's boy", starting right now. (door knock, Monica enters)

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Hey Rach!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Ready for your birthday lunch?

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Yeah I am, I am! Oh, but first of all, Monica, I would like to introduce you to my very talented colleage and more importantly my wonderful friend Gavin Mitchelle.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Pleased to meet you.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Pleased to meet you. So you're coming to Rachel's party tonight?

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh no no no no no, Gavin can't, he already has plans, most likely with his mother.

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Gavin Mitchell: Well I don't mind, I'll cancel. I would never miss my secretary's birthday. (leaves)

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Why did you invite him?? I can't stand that guy!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Monica Geller: You were just being so nice to him!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: I was faking it! Can't you tell when I'm being fake? (A man walks by)

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Hey, Mr Philips, nice suit!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Right there! That was so fake!

Friends S09E12, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Shh!

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: (to Monica) I still can't believe you invited Gavin. Allright, he is the last person I want to see.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Oh, you're welcome for the party. I'm glad you're having a good time.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: God, I hope he doesn't show up. Of course he's not gonna show up, the guy hates me.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Does he?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: What?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Maybe he's bothering you so much because he likes you. It's like in first grade when Skippy Langwild always pushed me on the playground because he secretly had a crush on me?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh, Monica, you think Skippy liked you? Honey, all those buys had a bet to see if he can knock you over.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Molly: (with Emma in a basinet) She's out, I'm gonna take her home.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh, ok, thank you. (Molly leaves) (to Monica) Do you see what all the guys see in her?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Wouldn't kick her out of bed. No more Vodka for me! (put her glass down) (Joey comes over)

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Rach, so can I sing happy birthday to you now?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Yeah, sure!

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Oh ... (Starts to sing) Happy birth ... (sees Molly leaving) oh, see you later (runs after Molly)

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Hey Rach, somebody got you shoes!

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh, give me! (opens the box happily, then gets freaked and throws away the box, she and Mon jump up the sofa)

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Be careful, be careful! These are my rat babies!

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Mike Hannigan: Yeah. We have rat babies now.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Ahhhh , you brought rats to my birthday party?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Monica Geller: So this is what a stroke feels like.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: I had to bring them! We killed their mother, they're our responsibility now. You know, they require constant care. You should know that, Rachel, you're a mother.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Are you comparing my daughter to a rat?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: No! Seven rats! I think we should take them home, we need feed them.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Rachel Green: whhh wait, you're gonna leave my party to take care of a box of rats?

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Well I'm sorry Rachel, but I'm not like you, ok? Not everyone can afford help. (she and Mike leave) (Ross gets out of the bathroom, sees Chandler)

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Where the hell are Joey and Molly? I asked you to watch them.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: (In a helium voice, holding a balloon) I'm sorry, I got a little occupied.

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Ross Geller: We have to stop them before something happens!

Friends S09E12, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: (still helium voice) Right behind you, big guy! (they both head for the door)

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: So you see, Molly, what people don't understand is that acting is a discipline. It takes a lot of hard work.

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Molly: So where did you study?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, I didn't go to college.

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Molly: No, where did you study acting?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Molly ... people don't study acting ... (Ross and Chandler walk in, Joey looks disappointed)

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Molly, ah, do you mind giving us just a minute?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Molly: Sure, I'll go check on Emma.

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Thanx. (Molly gets up and walks away)

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: (upset) Will the stable boy never get the princess??

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Ross Geller: What do you think you're gonna do, have sex with her right here on my couch?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: No ... the leather sticks to my ass. You know, this isn't fair. What makes you think that I'm just gonna sleep with her and then blow her off? Huh? Can't you guys open your minds to the possibility that I actally like her, and might want something real? (pause) Look, the truth is, I haven't felt this way about anyone since Rachel, ok? I didn't think I could ever love again. (pause)

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Chandler Bing & Ross Geller: Come on! Joe!

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: Ok (admits) (knock on door, Ross opens, it's a woman)

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Woman: Hi, is Molly here?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Yeah, come on in. Molly?

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Molly: (goes out of the room) Hey! Guys, this is Tabatha (they kiss on the lips in a romantic way). (to Ross) I'll see you tomorrow.

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Ross Geller: Ok ... (they leave the room, long pause) Well, uh, Joey, I guess we have no problem.

Friends S09E12, Scene 10
Joey Tribbiani: It's like my favorite fairy tale come true! (Chandler looks at him) The princess, the stable boy and the lesbian!

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Ok, ok, you start preparing the formula and I start changing the box and then we gotta put them straight to bed.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: Hey, when did we become one of those couples whose lives revolve around their rats?

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Well, you know what, they're our responsibility now.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: Ok, fine, these rats are our responsibility. What happens when they mate and there are hundreds of them?

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Mate? They're all brothers and sisters.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: Yeah - not such a problem with rats. No, they're more of a "love the one you're with" kind of animals.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: No. (opens the box) wh - get off your sister! Oh my god, what are we gonna do? We have 7 rats. So what if each of them has 7 rats? And then each of those have 7 rats? That's like ... (starts counting with her fingers) That's math I can't even do! What are we gonna do?

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: Well, I know this is gonna sound crazy, but, we could not let the box of rats ruin our lives.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, ok. I guess you're right. Allright, so we should just give them away. But to nice families, with children, and reduced fat wheat thins. They're Bob's favorites.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: It's gonna be ok.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: You must think I'm crazy.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Mike Hannigan: No, I think you're sweet.

Friends S09E12, Scene 11
Phoebe Buffay: Good. It's just so hard, it's hard for me to ... let them go. I guess it just brings back memories, you know, from ... when I gave birth to my brother's triplets and I had to give them up. (Mike is shocked) I haven't told you about that yet, have I?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Hey!

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Hi. Thanks for the party, honey. Should I help you clean up?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: No way! You had your party, now I have mine! Is everything alright?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Yeah, I just get a little bummed when my birthday's over.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Well, at least you have one thing to be happy about. That jerk Gavin from your office didn't show up (Gavin shows up at the balcony windows).

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Mmm hmm.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: Yeah, hey. (comes in to the balcony)

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Oh, we weren't talking about you. No, no way to recover.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: No. (Monica goes back inside)

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: Nice party.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Well, it was, and you would have seen it if you didn't showed up at (looks at his watch) ... 9:30?? God! Oh, this party was lame ...

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: (from inside) Again, you're welcome.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: Look, I'll just give you this and go.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Oh, you bought me a present! Why?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: Well, let me explain how birthday parties usually work. There are presents, and a cake, perhaps a fourth or fifth person. Ok, I ... got you the present to make up for being such a jerk to you earlier.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Aww. Well, ok, well that's very nice. And you wrote a card (opens the card). "From Gavin"

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: I really mean it.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: (opens the present, it's a green scarf) Awww, awww, it's beautiful.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: You don't mind? (puts it around her neck) Well, what do you know, it fits!

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: See, Gavin, you're capable of being a nice guy. Why did you give me such a hard time?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: I'm not sure.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Well Monica seems to think it's because you have feelings for me.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: I do have feelings for you.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: You do?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Gavin Mitchell: Yes, I feel that you are a little annoying.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Rachel Green: See? Why, Gavin, why? Right when I'm about to change my opinion of you, you go and you ... (he kisses her) and you do that ... (they kiss again) [cut to Ross from his appartment, holding baby toys and is shocked to see them kissing]

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: (sings in a helium voice) First I was afraid, I was petrified (very happy)

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: (walks in) Hey.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: (normal voice) Hi.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: Listen, I think I've left something here.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Oh, well someone left this (shows a green jacket). This is yours?

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: (likes the jacket) No, but I like it. I think I left one of my rat babies.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Oh, uh, well, I haven't seem it but if I do I'll let you know.

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Monica Geller: Ohmygod! Rat baby! Rat baby! Rat baby! (screams from another room)

Friends S09E12, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: (realizes) Ooh, maybe that's him!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Hey!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Yeah! Yeah! OK! Sure! Look! Can we...can we talk about what happened here last night?

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Sure! Just give me a second to get all huffy and weird like you! Do you believe that who everdid something over here last night did what they did or didn't do ...I mean come on!!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: OK you...you really don't know what I am talking about?

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: OK! Last night after the party I saw Rachel kissing that jerk from her office out on your balcony.

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Our balcony? Seriously? That's so funny because I told Monica we should put lights on our balcony. And she said"No, no. It's too cold, nobody will go out there." And I said "Maybe if we put some light out there they will"

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Right that's why I came over to talk about. Hum...I saw Rachel kissing some guy on your balcony,even though there were NO LIGHTS !

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: So are you gonna...talk to her?

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Why...Why should I? I mean if she wants to move on, that's fine!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: You know when "That's fine" sounds true when someone yells it and spits!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: No I'm serious. I mean she wants to date people? Fine! I don't care but...at least she could have told me. You knowI...I've been putting my life on hold and just concentrating on Emma but if she wants to go out there kissing guys shebarely knows, then so will I ! Very funny! Ross is gay! Ah! Ah!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No no no. Good. So you're moving on? Do you have any idea where you're moving?

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: I don't know. I mean I have plenty of opportunity. Just just now there were some women at the coffee house smiled at me.And then the other day on the subway a woman "accidentally" sat on my hand.

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Dude, don't rub my face in your crazy single life!

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Well, and how about this? There is an anthropologist at school who totally came on to me during the inter-departmentalPotluck dinner.

Friends S09E13, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Why did I get married?! [Opening Credits]

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey! Let me ask you guys something. I have a new headshot taken tomorrow right and the photographer said she thinks Ishould have my eyebrows waxed. Is that weird for a guy?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Well it depends.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: On...?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: On how far along he's in the sex change process!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: No I totally disagree. No I think it's fine for a guy to do something like that. Such you an actor. Not that you need to,your eyebrows are...

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Ok! Stop it you guys! Stop staring! You're freaking me out!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Your knuckles are kinda hairy too...

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Oh man! I have to get those done too?!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Wow! Talking about high maintenance.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey hey! You dye your hair!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: I'm a woman!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Arghhh! Double standards!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh before I forget, are you coming to Mike's piano bar tonight?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Only if I don't have to get up and sing.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: But everybody sings. It's so much fun! Last time this adorable old man got out there, forgot all of the words, flipped outand everyone booed him off the stage. So funny.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: It's just, I'm not good at singing.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh! What's the matter? Are you scared? You're afraid I'm a better singer? You're afraid I'm gonna beat you at singing?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: No no, it's not working on me. Wow! I must be growing up!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: OK fine! Please come and support Mike. You don't have to sing.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: So I don't have to sing and I can just sit there and pass judgments on others?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: While drinking...

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: I'm there!

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Hi guys! Listen I really need your help. I think I did something really stupid.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Well yes Rachel but you got something so beautiful out there.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Rachel Green: No not that. I kissed Gavin last night.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh my god.

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Monica Geller: You kissed him?

Friends S09E13, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Yeah. It was after the party, we were on the balcony and...

Friends S09E13, Scene 2

Monica Geller: Hey!

Friends S09E15, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Hey!

Monica Geller: What are you doing?

Friends S09E15, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Putting on the sneakers... thought I'd get into a younger mindset, you know, to see if it sparked anything.

Friends S09E15, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh, anything yet?

Friends S09E15, Scene 9

Friends S09E15, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: (entering) Hey!

Friends S09E15, Scene 9
#ALL#: Hey! (Joey heads straight for the fridge, takes all the beverage cans and is about to leave the apartment)

Joey Tribbiani: Probably wanna know what I'm doing...?

Chandler Bing: (sitting on the couch) You know what... these aren't half-bad! (to Rachel) You should suggest something like these to Ralph Lauren.

Chandler Bing: Alright (He stands wearing the sneakers on) I feel youger already! (He trips and falls hard on his back)

Phoebe Buffay: Hey, how was class?

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Ross Geller: (disbelieving) Wh-What are you talking about? It wasn't a girl. It was this huge dude.

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: You don't have to lie anymore, Ross, I know that it was a fourteen year-old girl.

Friends S09E15, Scene 10

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Yes, it was.

Friends S09E15, Scene 10

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: (interrupting, pinching his year) "Gimme your money, punk!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: (apologetic) Yeah, and I'm so, so sorry, Ross, I'm sorry, but, you know, if you think about it, it's kinda neat. (She smiles at him, but he doesn't understand) I mean, well, it's just that I I've always felt kinda like an outsider, you know, the rest of you have these connections that go way back and, you know, now, you and I have... have a great one!

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Ross Geller: It's not the best!

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: I know, I'm sorry, please forgive me. I don't know what to say.

Friends S09E15, Scene 10

Friends S09E15, Scene 10

Friends S09E15, Scene 10
Ross Geller: (interrupting) Hey, let's not do this! (He picks up his briefcase and walks out of the door, leaving Phoebe behind)

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: A-huh. So he's rolling down the street and he starts to lose control, you know... maybe he falls... maybe hurts himself. Just then, a kid comes flying by wearing the shoes. He jumps over the old guy and laughs, and the line reads: "Not suitable for adults!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Boss: Chandler, that's great!

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: Oh, thank you, sir... or man-who's-two-years-younger-than-me (He sits down again)

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Boss: You see? That has a clear selling point. It appeals to our key demographic, it's.... (enthusiastic) You did you come up with that?

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Chandler Bing: (over-enthusiastic) I don't know, I don' I don' know! I was just trying to get into a young mindset, you know, and it just started to flow.

Friends S09E15, Scene 11
Boss: That is great. Good work! Chandler. Thank you.

Friends S09E15, Scene 11

Friends S09E15, Scene 11

Friends S09E15, Scene 12

Phoebe Buffay: Yeah... but you should know, I also have a jar of vaseline and a cat skull in here.

Friends S09E15, Scene 12
Ross Geller: Still... this is amazing... Oh my god, thank you, Phoebe.

Friends S09E15, Scene 12
Phoebe Buffay: You're welcome. And thank you for "Science Boy". I learned a lot from him.

Friends S09E15, Scene 12
Ross Geller: You're welcome.

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: (hoping frantically on the spot, screaming) "I need an answer!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: "I-I-I can't tell you somethin' I don't know."

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: "You know!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: "I don't know!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: "I need an answer now!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: "Alright, here, you want an answer... the answer... is..." (He pauses while Joey struggles to avoid wetting his pants)

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: (screaming) Oh!

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: "She never loved me, she only loved you."

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: "You knew this all along and you never told me? You never told me? I can never forgive you, I can never forgive myself, I have nothing to live for Bang End Scene!"

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: Absolutely amazing! (The producers applaud Joey) The part is yours.

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Joey Tribbiani: (in pain) Oh thanks, thanks! Now, I really have to get.

Friends S09E15, Scene 13
Lennart: Wa-wa-wa-wait! Congratulations! You did it! You did it! (He hugs Joey) You can relax now. Yeah. (Joey relaxes and wets his pants while hugging Lennart)

Friends S09E15, Scene 14
Monica Geller: Wow, that's a big cable bill! Huh, you don't have a job, but you have no problem ordering porn... on a Saturday afternoon?! (shocked) I was in the house!

Friends S09E15, Scene 14

Monica Geller: ... everybody we know? Yeah.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: I'm not sure what they did, but I'm inclined to blame Enron.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Monica Geller: I guess with you doing the internship, we're just spending more than we're bringing in.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Maybe I should quit and get a job that pays.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Oh, But you're finally doing something that you love! I can't ask you to give that up. Though it'd be nice if the thing that you love was y'know... finding gold.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: You know what? You know what? I think we're making too big a deal out of this. ok? So we pay our bills a little late this month and maybe next month we cut back on a few things. And maybe we start eating out of Joey's refrigerator for a change. You're chef... what can you make out of backing soda and beer?

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Ok worse case scenario is...we borrow some money from my parents.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: No! We're not borrowing money.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Why not?

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Wow! I Had no idea you had this much pride.

Friends S09E16, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: That's right! I do! And I'm your man. And I'm going to get us through this situation even if it means you working twice as hard.

Phoebe Buffay: Why??

Phoebe Buffay: Oh...you don't have to go, I have something that will fit you.

Phoebe Buffay: I want you to stay.

Mike Hannigan: I want to stay too but I've gone as bad as much use out of these boxers as I can..

Phoebe Buffay: Why don't you turn them inside ou...

Mike Hannigan: Done it. (Phoebe becomes a little more subdued) I'll be back in a couple of hours.

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: I'll miss you.

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Mike Hannigan: Me too. (He leaves. A few moments later, he enters again.) You know what? I just realised something. I don't wanna go home.

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Great! Ok...I'll go get the tube top.

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Mike Hannigan: No, no! What I mean is, I hate going back to my apartment now... and partly because I live above a known crack den but... mostly because when I'm there, It's just, I really miss you. So.. do you want to move in together?

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Wow, Mike Hannigan...You sure know how to make a girl say "Hell yeah!"

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Mike Hannigan: So we're doing it?

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah! Let's do it! Let's live together! (They embrace and Mike kisses Phoebe) Oh god, we're really going to move in together!

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Mike Hannigan: Yeah!

Friends S09E16, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: I've always wanted to live with a guy. "Pick up your socks!" "Put down the toilet seat!" "No! We're not having sex anymore!" It's gonna be fun!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Hey Joey!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Listen...I need to know that what I'm about to ask you, will never get back to Chandler. (Joey frowns...then looks as if he understands)

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I'd be lying if I said I haven't thought about it myself. Chandler is my best friend, it would be wrong. Good...(He winks)...But wrong.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: (Looks exasperated) Ok first of all...It would be great. But that's not what I'm here to talk to you about. I need to borrow some money.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Aww, I don't know Monica y'know... erm... lending friends money is always a mistake.

Monica Geller: But Chandler lent you money!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: And I think he would tell you it was a mistake.

Monica Geller: Come on...I just need it for some rent and..and some other bills.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh...how much?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Two thousand dollars?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Two thousand dollars!? What do you think I am? I soap opera star!?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Yeah...

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: That's right I am! (Opens drawer and rummages through it. Rachel enters)

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Hi you guys!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani & Monica Geller: Hey!

Joey Tribbiani: Oo...what's in the bag?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Oh er... well you know Emma started crawling? I realised that this place, is very unsafe for a baby. So I went to the store and got some stuff to baby-proof the apartment.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh...baby-proofing... Why is this such a big deal now? Y'know, when I was a kid it was like.. "Whoops! Joey fell down the stairs!" or er.. "Whoops! Joey electrocuted himself again!" Huh!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Anyway erm, are you going to get a handyman to install this stuff?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: No. I was just going to do this myself. (Joey makes a sarcastic laugh.)

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: You're gonna do it?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Yeah, Why? You don't think a woman can do this?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, women can. You can't.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Monica...would you please tell Joey that he is a pig?

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Monica Geller: You're a pig. And you can't do this.

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Wha!? What!? Come on! I found the hardware store all by myself!

Friends S09E16, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: The hardware store is right down the street.

Rachel Green: There is a hardware store right down the street?

Phoebe Buffay: Hey you guys! Ok, we've got great news.

Mike Hannigan: Phoebe and I are moving in together.

Chandler Bing & Monica Geller & Ross Geller: Congratulations!/Good for you!/Great!

text:
Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I know it's so exciting! You know I've never lived with a guy before.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Well you know it's just like living with a girl. Only they don't steal your makeup. Unless they're playing "This is what my sister would look like" (Looks at Chandler)

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Yeah.... she's not so cute.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Mike Hannigan: I'm gonna go to the bathroom.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Okay, well you put down the toilet seat.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Mike Hannigan: Yes dear.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Is that a bit you guys do?

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Uh huh...we're playing you two.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Monica Geller: We don't do that! Tell her we don't do that!

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Chandler Bing: Yes dear.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Ross Geller: I can't believe you guys are moving in together. That's, that's great! I mean...I'm happy for you guys..

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Monica Geller: I hear wedding bells.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Monica slow down! Ok? I'm just excited to be living with him. You know I mean, I don't know, Can I see someday being married to Mike? Sure! Yeah. Y'know..I can picture myself walking down the aisle in a wedding dress that highlights my breasts in an obvious yet classy way. But do I want that house in Connecticut...you know..near the good schools where Mike and I can send Sophie and Mike Junior.. Oh my god I do.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Phoebe, I had no idea you were so conventional.

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I know! I guess I am! Oh my god! Load up the Volvo I want to be a soccer mom!

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Mike Hannigan: You ready to go?

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah! You bet roomy!

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Monica Geller: Don't you mean..groomy?

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Mike Hannigan: What are you talking about?

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Oh please, these guys, we haven't even moved in yet and they have us picking out china patterns. (Mike seems to gag a little...and laughs nervously. They begin to leave. Phoebe bolts back)

Friends S09E16, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: China patterns!!!!!

Friends S09E16, Scene 5
Rachel Green: This is easy...Can't do this! (Moves away...and finds her sweater sleeve stuck to the drawer) Oh! Wow! Seriously I can't do this. (Fiddles more)

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Hey Joe!

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Listen er..I need to ask you a favor but you can't tell Monica anything about it.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: I thought you didn't have secrets from Monica.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: And that would have made the official party line. (Joey nods) Monica and I are having a little financial trouble.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, I know.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: What? What do you mean you know?

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Err... I just figured it out! You know, I mean you're not working and the economy is bad.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Oh! Right.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: (to himself) That's the fastest I have ever thought!

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Anyway, err... I need to borrow some money.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Oh! Sure! How much? Two thousand dollars?

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Yes! Two thousand dollars exactly! How do you know that! (Joey begins writing a cheque)

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Err...Well I...Know how much you used to make and I know how much your rent is. (shrugs)

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Oh ok.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: (To himself) I am on fire! Chandler (Stands up and walks to Joey): Listen...this is really nice. Do you... (sees his chequebook) Did you write a cheque to Monica for two thousand dollars? Did Monica borrow money from you?

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Err... Kind of.

Chandler Bing: I can't believe her! Did she tell you we were having money problems?

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Oh no no no no no... It wasn't... It wasn't because of your money problems, it was for something for her.

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: What?

Friends S09E16, Scene 6
Joey Tribbiani: Something personal.

Chandler Bing: What would she get for herself for two thousand dollars that she wouldn't tell me about? (Woman with huge breasts cuts across them. Takes Joey's coffee)

Woman: Excuse me.

Joey Tribbiani: Boob job.

Monica Geller: I don't want her to get a boob job! That's crazy!

Joey Tribbiani: Well it's...It's not that crazy okay? Making them smaller, that would be crazy.

Mike Hannigan: Well hey, I wanna ask you about Monica's little "groomy" joke.

Phoebe Buffay: Oh! Alright. Well I think the reason people laugh is becuase it's a play on the word roomy.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Oh no! No no! Not at all. We're just moving in right now. See where it goes.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Mike Hannigan: Yeah well, that's the thing. For me it's as far as it can ever go.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: What do you mean?

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Mike Hannigan: Look. Phoebe, I-I love you. Very much. But I never want to get married again.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Oh. Wow.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Mike Hannigan: It's just my first marriage was, you know such a disaster. I kind of lost faith in the whole idea.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Was it really that bad?

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Mike Hannigan: At one point near the end she deliberately defecated.....

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Ok, well that's bad. But don't you think it might be different with someone else? Perhaps a blonde who always uses a toilet. Except for once in the ocean.

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Mike Hannigan: Look it's not about who I would marry. And I was certain the first time I got married it would last forever. And I was totally wrong!

Friends S09E16, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: But it's just...

text:

Phoebe Buffay: One, two, three! (they break the wishbone)

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

You know, we're gonna be all like "oh everybody, let's take our helicopters up to the cape" and you're gonna be all like "oh, I can't guys, I'll meet you guys up there, I gotta gas up the Hyundai"

Chandler Bing: Ooh! Calm down ...

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Seriously, that's your fantasy? To invest it?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Ooh, ooh, I know! We should pool all own money and buy the Knicks!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: You're right, it has been you dream for over 15 seconds.

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: (looks around) I'll take this one too (to Ross) Uh ... Mommy?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: I'm hoping that if she hears it enough it will be her first word.

Phoebe Buffay: Oooh, I like that, "daddy" (in a sexy tone)

Phoebe Buffay: (still in sexy tone) Oooh, is daddy getting angry? Is daddy gonna spank me?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Hello? Hello? Oh, hey Charlie. Did anybody else hear? ... What? Susan got it?? How? Oh man, I would have slept with him!! .. Alright, bye. (hangs up)

Joey Tribbiani: Dude, I'm sorry. But hey, there's one spot left, right?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Well no, Charlie's gonna get that.

Monica Geller: Hey, don't say that! You got just as good a chance as anybody else of getting that job!

Chandler Bing: He's the boss's son.

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Ooh, you guys, it starts in like 20 minutes.

Monica Geller: Ok, here we go. We need to sort out the tickets as quickly as possible to see if we've won. So does anybody have any ideas how to organize this? (doesn't let them answer) Ok, how about this: we divide them into 6 groups of 40, and the remaining 10 can be read by whoever finishes their pile first.

Rachel Green: Ooh, I have another idea!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Monica Geller: I'm sorry, idea time is over.

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Ok, well, are all the tickets in the bowl?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Yeah.

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: What about the ones you have on the nightstand?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Monica Geller: There are no tickets on the nightstand!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Yes there are, I just saw them a few minutes ago. (Rachel get suspicious)

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Un, no you didn't! You must be mistaken!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Honey, there are like 20 tickets on the nightstand!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Chandler, sense the tone!! (Rachel comes out of their bedroom waving tickets)

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well, well, well, look what mommy found!! (everyone's shocked)

Monica Geller: Hey, you just got in 5 minutes ago!

Joey Tribbiani: I was with you the whole time we were in Connecticut, when did you even get those?

Monica Geller: When you were reading the dirty magazines without taking off the plastic!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (to Ross) I'll show you how.

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Ok, well Monica, suppose one of your "special" tickets win? How are you gonna feel when you win the lottery and you lose all your friends?

Monica Geller: Please ... if I win the lottery, you guys are not gonna leave me. Someone gave me a basket of mini-muffins last week and I couldn't get rid of you for 3 days!

Monica Geller: Ahhh! (shocked)

Monica Geller: Fine! Don't be my friends! I'll buy new friends! Yeah, and then I'll pay for their plastic surgery so they'd look just like you!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (surprised) OH! Alright, you know what? That's it! I want my share of the tickets (picks up the bowl)!

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Friends S09E18, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Ok, that's it! Just give'em to me! I'll split them up! (she tries to snatch the bowl from Joey's hands but she can't, so she pinches his nipple and she manages to take it)

Joey Tribbiani: (in pain) Oh!

Phoebe Buffay: Don't come any closer!

Chandler Bing: Can I come a little bit closer, valuable things are getting squished...

Phoebe Buffay: No, what's more important, your friends or money?

Friends S09E18, Scene 2

Phoebe Buffay: Hey Monica, what about your extra tickets?

Chandler Bing: Oh, is she related to Ralph Lauren?

Monica Geller: (she hugs Chandler) Honey, you've been really strong about this, I know how badly you wanted that job.

Chandler Bing: Yeah, you know, I really thought I deserved it. (pause) But... let's go win the lottery... I mean, we still have 130 chances to win, right?

Rachel Green: (searching the dictionary) Alright, okay, okay, gleba, gleba... (excited) Gleba! Ha! Here it is: the fleshy, spore-bearing inner mass of a certain fungi. (Rachel shows Ross the definition on the dictionary, giving him a smug look; then she squints at the dictionary, as though unsure what to make out of it)

Chandler Bing: No.

Chandler Bing: Oh no no no no, I'd love to be somebody's assistant! Answering phones, getting coffee, I live for that stuff! And I'm not too mature... farts, boobies, butt cracks!

Chandler Bing: What? (pause) Oh, yeah, I'm gonna be a junior copywriter.

Monica Geller: Oh sweetie, I'm so proud of you!

Chandler Bing: Does that mean I get the good loving tonight?

Joey Tribbiani: Oh yeah.

Phoebe Buffay: You guys, what was the Powerball number again?

Monica Geller & Ross Geller: Seven.

Phoebe Buffay: We won.

Rachel Green: What?

Friends S09E18, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: We won!

Phoebe Buffay: Don't tear it.

Chandler Bing: Me too.

Joey Tribbiani: Me too.

Rachel Green: Me too. (they all look at Ross)

Joey Tribbiani: (sitting in a chair) Hey guys, so I just called the Powerball hotline, can you believe it? Nobody won.

Friends S09E18, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I beg to differ (shows him her cup of coffee and her plate of cookies).

Gunther: Maybe nobody won the jackpot, but there was this guy in here earlier, and he found the ticket on the street, right outside, and won $10,000 (goes to the counter). (They all glare evilly at Phoebe)

Phoebe Buffay: (hides her mouth behind the cup and speaks in the "pigeon voice" from before) Coo, again. Don't blame the pretty lady. It was not her fault. It was me, the pigeon, coo! (pause) Seriously, stop staring at her. (Joey stares around dumbly looking for the "talking pigeon")

Joey Tribbiani: (talking to a pineapple in his hand) God, you're beautiful...why are we fighting this?You know you want it to happen as much as I do. (Rachel comes out of her room and starts staring at him unseen)Joey: I want you.I need you.Let me make love to you.

Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, that was a disappointment...(pause) Oh, hey!D'you want to come down to the set and tell me if I'm doing ok?
