Friends S10E03, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Well, aren't you a treat.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I can't believe you tried to cut me out. Why Phoebe, why?

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: It was right after we were living together and you were driving me crazy, okay? You were really controlling and compulsive and shrill.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I'm still all those things!

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: You're also so generous and kind and scrappy!

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: (starts smiling) I am scrappy.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Exactly! Look, no matter what I tried to do, I couldn't keep you out of my life. Of all the people I have cut out, you were the only one who ever clawed her way back in.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: It's because I'm scrappy.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, you are. And I'm so glad that you fought your way back in, because I don't know what I would do without you.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: I won't know what I would do without you. (They hug)

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Monica Geller: Well, I guess we should go back in. When you gave me another chance, I guess we should do the same for Amanda.

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, I guess you're right. (They both enter the apartment again, where Amanda is "dancing" for Chandler, but she's really terrible at it)

Friends S10E03, Scene 10
Amanda Buffamonteezi: Can you believe it. I've never had any professional dance training. (Monica and Phoebe look at each other and leave the apartment again)

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Glenda: Now, let me explain how this works. You go into the booth, and...

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Ross Geller: I'm gonna stop you right there, Glenda. Okay? Does it look like this is my first time, huh? Now I want 4 two's... and I want them all on my back.

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Glenda: (quietly) Okay... (Ross enters the room, takes off his robe and enters the booth. He stands with his back to the nozzles and then realises that this booth has nozzles at both sides of the wall)

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Wait a minute, there's two sets of nozzles, which one is it? (He turns around frantically from side to side.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Ross Geller: Which... which... which... Which one is it? (He then stops turning, facing one of the nozzles, which starts spraying in this face and front again.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 11
Ross Geller: OH! SON OF A BITCH! (He now turns to the other side, which also starts spraying his face and front.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: What is the matter with us?

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Well, I know what's the matter with me.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: No, I mean with us, you know. I mean, is it supposed to be this... difficult?

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: I don't know. (Chandler enters the apartment)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: That fake British woman is a real bitch, but she sure can dance... Hey!

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Hi! Hey, listen, can we ask you a question? When you and Monica first hooked up, was it weird going from friends to... more than that?

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Kinda... you know, sneaking around, having to hide from you guys...

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: No, no, no... No, I mean... se-x-u-ally...

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, was there a part of you that... felt like it was... really wrong?

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: Actually, no. No, it felt right. You know, it felt like uhm... I can't believe we haven't been doing this the whole time. (Rachel and Joey are still looking at Chandler, slowly letting his words get to them)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Chandler Bing: I can tell from your expressions that that's the good news you were hoping for... Well, I'm gonna go continue to... spread the joy.(Chandler leaves the apartment. Joey sighs)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Well, just because it happened that way for them doesn't mean it has to happen that way for us.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, yeah... Absolutely. I mean, just because something's difficult doesn't mean that you quit.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Right, totally.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, so we just keep trying and trying until we... do it.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Yeah, and if doesn't work, then we'll be just one of those couples that never have sex.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: That's a... pla-an. (They both stare for a while, and then look at each other)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: (sighs) Wow... I did not see this coming.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: I know.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: I don't get it. I mean, I was so sure this was what I wanted.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Hmmm... Me too... (She puts her head on Joey's shoulder and Joey kisses her on her head.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: I wonder how Monica and Chandler could do it?

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: I guess they weren't as good friends as we are. (Lifts her head from Joey's shoulder)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Aah... I bet you're right. (They look at each other for a while)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: So...

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Yeah.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: I love ya.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Rachel Green: Love you too... Alright, I'm going to bed.

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, me too. (Rachel gets up, and Joey tries to get up, but halfway up he sits down again.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 12
Joey Tribbiani: Ooh, yeah, I'm not going anywhere for a while. (Joey takes the ice-bucket with the champagne bottle in it and puts it on his sore spot)

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: Dude, it's Chandler. Let me in. (Ross's face is now a VERY dark shade of brown.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Ross Geller: Go away! I don't want to see anybody.

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: I know, I went to the tanning place and the same thing happened to me. You have to let me in.

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Ross Geller: Really? Did you count Mississipily? (Ross walks to the door and opens it.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Ross Geller: Dude, you're not tanned.

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: No, I just had to get a picture of this. (Chandler holds up a camera and takes Ross's picture.)

Friends S10E03, Scene 13
Chandler Bing: I see you later! (Ross closes the door) end.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: (she enters) Hey guys!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Chandler Bing & Rachel Green & Ross Geller: Hey!

metadata.speaker: Chandler Bing & Rachel Green & Ross Geller

text:
Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Honey, I got us that room at the Woodford Inn this weekend.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: That place in Vermont? You can take a hint!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Rachel Green: Wait, you can't go away this weekend! It's Emma's birthday!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Yeah!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Rachel Green: We're having a party.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Well, can't you just have the party when we get back?

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Ross Geller: No.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Rachel Green: No, that day... that won't be her real birthday!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Gee if only she were one and had no idea what the hell a birthday was!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Ross Geller: C'mon you guys, this is really important to us.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Well, I'm sorry, but Chandler and I could really use a weekend away. You know, to reconnect... emotionally.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: There's this thing I really want us to do. I read about it in Maxim...

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Rachel Green: Well, can't you just go to Vermont the next day?

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Yeah, we want everyone to be there. As much as I hate to delay your doing weird sex stuff to my little sister.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Rachel Green: And I mean, you know, you guys... This is a big deal. I mean, how can we have her first birthday party without her aunt and her uncle!

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: All right, we'll stay. We can just drive up after the party.

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Fine, but if we end up not doing this Maxim thing because of this party...

Friends S10E04, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Believe me, that is not why we won't be doing that!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: You know Pheebs, when I was little, on my birthday, my daddy would hide a present in every room of the house, and then he would draw a treasure map to help me find 'em all.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oooh, I love family traditions like that. When uhm... when Ursula and I were kids, on our birthday, our stepdad would sell his blood to buy us food!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (he enters) Hey guys!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey, I brought the camera for Emma's video.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh, good, good! We had this idea to make a birthday video for Emma and we'll give it to her when she is 18.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, COOL!! Wow, it's like a time capsule!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Yeah!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, just think... she's gonna be watching that video on a TV that hasn't even been invented yet! With friends who right now are just like babies! And they'll be living in a floating city that the humans built to escape the ant people!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: That's the hope! So, is Emma awake yet?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh no, it's still nap time. But she'll be up soon.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Ah, and where is Joey?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: I said it's still nap time. (Joey comes out from his room, yawning)

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (taping Joey with the cam) Hey, there is uncle Joey!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey, say something to Emma on her 18th birthday!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: 18, uh? (starts to prepare himself to say his "How You Doin'" line)

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Joey, NO!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: What, what!? it's for her hot friends!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: When they see this you'll be 52!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: And starting to think about settling down!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Hey Joey, will you please set this up for people to put Emma's presents on?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I'd love to! Yeah!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (To Phoebe) We were supposed to bring presents?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah! I wrote Emma a song.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, yeah! How was I supposed to know?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Joey, it's a birthday party.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, but for a one-year-old. What's the point... the other day she laughed for like an hour at a cup. Just a cup with a picture of Elmo on it dressed as a farmer. And he's standing next to this cow and the cow says "El-moo"! (Joey starts laughing) Yeah... that's a funny cup! (Monica and Chandler enter)

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Hey!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Hey hey! Where's the birthday girl?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh, she's still napping.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: Oh, sure, she was probably up all night, excited about the party she knows is happening.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Look, I know that you guys really want to get to Vermont and this isn't a really big deal to you, but it really is to us, ok? Emma will never have a first birthday again.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: All right... you're right. We're sorry. Now let's wake up Emma and get the fun time started!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: No really, she didn't sleep well last night, so we can't wake her up.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: Are you freaking kidding me, Green? (someone knocks on the door. Rachel goes to open it)

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Jack Geller & Judy Geller: HI!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (points the camcorder towards them to record their entrance) Hey!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: So glad you came!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Jack Geller: I can't believe Emma is already one!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Judy Geller: (to Monica) I remember your first birthday! Ross was jealous of all the attention we were giving you. He pulled on his testicles so hard! We had to take him to the emergency room!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (pointing the camcorder at himself) There's something you didn't know about your dad!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Mr. and Mrs. Geller! Let me help you with that.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Jack Geller: Thank you!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Oh man, this is great, uh? The three of us together again! You know what would be fun? If we gave this present to Emma from all of us!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Jack Geller: Which one are you? (Time lapse)

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: I can't believe Emma is still asleep!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I know, what are we gonna do?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Monica Geller: I've got a plan. I've got a plan. I'm going to ram this platter really hard into your ribs. You're gonna scream out and that'll wake her up!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I'm not going to Vermont with this Monica!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey Pheebs, you know what? I was thinking... since you wrote a song, maybe I could do something for Emma using my talents!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: So you're gonna... hit on her?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: No, no, no! My talents as an actor!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: You know, I could like maybe... I could do a dramatic reading of one of her books!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Or you could stick a fork in an apple!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, I think Emma might like it!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh! Emma might like what?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Um, my present!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: What did you get her?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Actually we prepared performances.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Separate performances.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: But equally real!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well, this sounds like fun! Well, you know what? Actually? People are getting a little antsy waiting Emma to wake up from her nap, so would you mind performing them once now?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Sure, yeah!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (unconfidently) O K.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (to everybody) All right, let's get this party started, huh? Joey and Phoebe are gonna perform a little something for us.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Oh, great!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: (to Joey) Are you gonna be embarrassed going up there having nothing prepared?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, I do it every week with three cameras pointed at me and a whole crew waiting!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: So, Joey, what are you gonna do for us?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I will be doing a dramatic reading of one of Emma's books.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh, ok, which one?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Uh, why, it's a... (he picks a book up) one of her favorites, uh, (he reads the title of the book) "Riding the Storm Out. Coping with post-partum depression" eesh! (he puts the book back and picks up another) "Love you forever". Love you forever. By Robert Munsch. Published by Firefly books. Printed (he pauses and changes the tone to a dramatic one) in Mexico. A mother held her new baby and very slowly rocked him back and forth, back and forth, back and forth, and while she held him she sang "I'll love you forever, I'll like you for always, as long as I'm living, my baby you'll be". (the picture fades and Joey is now finishing the book). And while he rocked her, he sang "I'll love you forever, I'll like you for always, as long as I'm living, my baby you'll be".

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (crying) Wow! That was amazing!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Thank you so much for that gift!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Chandler Bing: I was not ready for this today!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Amazing... amazing.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh, Phoebe, I'm sorry! Phoebe has prepared something as well.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: That's right, I've prepared a song for Emma. From my heart to hers. For there's no greater gift, than the gift of music. (she starts singing) Emma! Your name poses a dilemma. 'Cause not much else rhymes with Emma! Maybe the actor Richard Crenna, he played the commanding officer in Rambo. Happy birthday Emma!

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Is that it?

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: No, of course not! I also, you know, prepared a reading (she picks up a book). "Sex and the single mother. (pause) Finding your G-spot.

Friends S10E04, Scene 2
#ALL#: No, no, no, no, no!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: Hello Emma. Happy eighteenth birthday.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Jack Geller: Right now that seems so far away, seventeen years.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: Yes, you'll be all grown up by then. We'll be... Well your grandfather and I might not be here.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Jack Geller: That's true! This message could becoming to you from beyond the grave, Emma!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: After all, my parents died very young.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Jack Geller: And my cholesterol's off the charts!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: Remember, Emma, heart disease kills women too!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Ok, cut! Great. That was... that was just... yeah!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Ross, um, don't forget to get a shot of Emma's cake. It's in a box in the fridge.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Sure.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Oh, you're gonna love this cake. I got it from a bakery in New Jersey, Corino's.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Oh my God, that place has the creamiest frosting! I use to hitchhike there when I was a kid.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Well, anyway, they make these great novelty cakes, in all different shapes, and if you give them a photo, they'll copy it in icing!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Oh, did you do a picture of Emma?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Yes! On a cake shaped like a bunny.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Uh, Rach? Does this bakery by any chance also bake erotic cakes? Say for bachelorette parties?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Ross, what are you talking about? (she sees the cake) oh! Oh my God! They put my baby's face on a penis!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: oh! Now it's a party!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Why you guys this isn't funny, all right? If I wanted this cake to be a disaster I would have baked it myself!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Uh.. is it ok that I still think it looks delicious?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: (to Jack) Jack, look at this.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Jack Geller: I know what you're thinking Judy, the resemblance is uncanny!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: I am this close to tugging on my testicles again.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: No, no, this is not what I ordered. Ok? I went all the way to New Jersey so that I could have the perfect cake for my daughter's birthday and I need a bunny cake, right now!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Ask them if it would be faster if we cut the baby's face off the penis, so we can put it on the bunny. (pause). That is a weird sentence!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: Oh! Believe you me! I am going to bring this cake back, I don't even want it in my home... (Turns towards the cake and sees Joey trying to take a piece and yells at him) Joey, don't touch it!!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: I'm so confused!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Rachel Green: (speaking to the person on the phone again) Yes, yes. I still want my daughters picture, but on a bunny cake. Yellow cake, chocolate frosting with nuts!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: To be fair this one does have nuts. (Time lapse) (Ross, Chandler and Monica are in the kitchen area)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Hey Mon, that was really nice of you to loan Rachel your car so she could go and get the cake.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Oh. So nice of her to pull my hair, 'till I dropped the key!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Well, you know what? While we're waiting, you guys could tape your message to Emma for her 18th birthday, huh? (takes the camcorder and points it at Monica and Chandler) Ok!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Hi Emma! It's the year 2020. Are you still enjoying your nap?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: We're Aunt Monica and uncle Chandler, by the way. You may not recognize us, because we haven't spoken to your parents in seventeen years!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: We used to be married, but then we missed a weekend away together and things kind of unraveled. Because of you! Happy Birthday. (Ross looks disappointed and switches the camcorder off)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Ross, Rachel promised it would be over by now. We seriously have to go, if we want to get to Vermont. I called them and the last train leaves in a half hour.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: And you know, I have a massage client soon.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: You guys, just please.. a little bit longer. I promise, Rachel will be back with the cake any minute. Monica, remember.. the frosting? huh?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Alright, 5 more minutes. (The phone rings, Ross picks up)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: (Into receiver) Hello? (listens) Oh no! What happened? (listens some more) Ok ok, where are you? (Grabs a pen and starts writing). Ok, I'll be right there. (Puts the phone down)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Was that Emma? Is she up?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: No, Rachel got pulled over for speeding. She forgot her licence so now I have to bring it to her.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Well, if you're leaving, I'm definitely gonna go.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Monica Geller: No! Wait! If anybody gets to go.. it's us (Points at herself and Chandler) We've been complaining the longest!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: No, wait ! You guys, no, no, you can't leave! Rachel already feels bad that the cake's messed up. How do you think she's gonna feel when she comes back here and all you guys are gone?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: I don't know! You'll tell us on Monday!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Ross Geller: Joey! You're in charge, ok? You make sure nobody leaves! (leaves)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Got it! (Goes towards the front door and stands with his back to it) Hey hey hey! (to Chandler) Where do you think you're going?

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: To the bathroom!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Alright, well the rest of you get comfortable, ok, because we're gonna be here for a li...(stops and thinks) Wait a minute, there is a window in there!

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: Oh no! He's not getting away that easy! (Phoebe and Joey run towards the bathroom and enter)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: (Yelling) What are you doing? Get the hell out of here! (Phoebe and Joey come out looking shocked)

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: Well, that one did not have Emma's face on it.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Phoebe Buffay: No, it did not.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Joey Tribbiani: No.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Judy Geller: Well, we better get going, it's late. Jack's not allowed to drive at night anymore. He has trouble staying in his lane.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3
Jack Geller: Last winter I went up on a church lawn and drove right through a manger scene. The papers thought it was a hate crime.

Friends S10E04, Scene 3

Friends S10E08, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: No. Here (he tears off the pocket from Ross' shirt, and tears off everything below that as well.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 7
Ross Geller: (to Joey) HEY!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Do you hear something? (Chandlers stands up and goes to the door to look out from the peephole)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (peeping) They're out there!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Ohhh! Let me see! Oh God, I can't believe this! They're an hour late and they're just staying out there, talking!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (peeping) Everything is so distorted! Looks like Joey has a giant hand! Which says "Rangers" on it. They went to the game!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (gasps) Oooh! They are in for a world of pain!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (looking through the peephole again) Ross' shirt is torn.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh! They're late and they're sloppy! [Cut to the hall] (Rachel comes out of her apartment}

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Alright, Emma is napping... (then to Ross) what happened to your shirt?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I got mugged. And they stole my pocket.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: We're just... we're trying to figure out an excuse. Hey! Ooh! How about this: We can say that Monica told us 5 o'clock, not 4 o'clock. That way we're right on time! (Others start to agree but she continues) OR... or, we can plant PCP in the apartment and call the cops on her.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (sarcastic) That would be a good way to get rid of all the PCP we have lying around.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: You know what, we just say that she said it was 5 o'clock. We'll just act casual. We're not late, we're right on time. (When she finishes talking, a note is pushed from under Monica's and Chandler's door, into the hall. Ross picks it up and reads it out loud)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (Reading the note) We know you're out there. (Rachel gasps)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (whispering) Who do you think its from? [time lapse - they are still in the hall]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, God. This is bad. This is so bad.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Well, let's just go in there and face them.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Well, I'm not going in first. I bet that vein on Monica's forehead is popping like crazy.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I hate that thing, it's like a... bolt of lightning.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, hey, I have an idea. Why don't we play rock-paper-scissors, and whoever loses goes in first. (they all agree) Ready? (they do the rock-paper-scissor thing with they hands and Rachel has paper, Phoebe and Ross both have rock, while Joey is doing a strange upward wiggling with his fingers. They all look a him confused).

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (smiling from ear to ear) Ah-haah! I win!!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: What is that?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: That's fire. Beats everything.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, really? Does it beat water balloon? (She places her hand over his "fire" and mimics a bursting water balloon, thus putting the fire out).

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Ooh! Well played, Phoebe Buffay, well played.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Alright, enough, enough, come on. Let's just all go in at the same time.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
#ALL#: Alright, okay. (Phoebe reaches for the door, and tries to open it but it's locked)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: It's locked.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Wha...? Oh sure, now they lock it, but when they're having sex on the couch, its like: "Come on in, my butt is surprisingly hairy".

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Alright, come on... (starts to knock on the door) Alright, you guys. We're so sorry we're late. Please let us in, so we can have dinner together. [cut to Monica and Chandler]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: No! Everything's cold. The turkey's dried out and the... the stuffing is all soggy.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Yeah, and there's a bowl of cranberry sauce that... (speaking lower to Monica) what happens to cranberry sauce?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (Rolling her eyes) Nothing. It's fine.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (relieved) Oh thank God! [cut to the hall]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Come on you guys, we're sorry, alri...? Our subway broke down.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (looking through the peephole) That's a lie, you went to the game, I can see Joey's hand.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (to Joey, who is wearing a blue, 3 foot hand) FOR THE LOVE OF GOD TAKE IT OFF!! (takes it off his hand and throws it on the floor)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: You guys, come on, it doesn't matter why we're late. We're all here now, please let us in so we can have some of your delicious turkey. (A slice of turkey on a piece of aluminum foil is slid under door)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I had a dream once about a fax machine that did that. (Ross picks it up) [cut to Monica and Chandler]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: That's all the turkey you're gonna get. [cut to the hall]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: How are we gonna decide who gets this?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (holds his fist up) WATER BALLOON! (he stuffs the slice in is mouth and gives the foil back to Ross)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: What are we gonna do? I'm starving.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: (gasps) Oh, I just remembered. We do have something to eat. Monica put something in our oven this morning.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Oh yeah! [cut to Monica and Chandler]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Hey, you touch that and you will be sorry.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Guys, I'd listen to her. The vein is bigger than I've ever seen it. (Monica looks at Chandler) [cut to the hall] (Rachel comes out of the apartment holding a pot. Joey holds in anticipation and Rachel opens it)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Huh... OH MY GOD IT'S BRUSSELS SPROUTS. (they all look appalled)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: That's worse than no food. [cut to Monica and Chandler] (Monica looks insulted)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: HA-HA! All you got was Monica's stinky Brussels sprouts!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Stinky?!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Please let me stay on this side of the door. [cut to hall]

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh, I know... I still have my old key! (She goes in to get it and comes back with her keys) We can just unlock the door.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Well, I don't know if that's such a good idea. They clearly don't want to be with us.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: You know what? I don't want to be with them either, but it's Thanksgiving and we should not want to be together, together. (Goes to unlock the door)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (to Ross) Just get in there and make a face to face apology, you know? Look them in the eye. I know I can get them to forgive us.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I don't know...

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I'm telling ya... (his eyes open wide and he looks like his eyes are about to pop out. He stares at Ross like this without blinking) I can do it.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (Staring back, and then breaks off) (To Phoebe and Rachel) Yeah, he can do it! (Rachel finally manages to open the door, but the door chain is on.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Oh! (Joey sticks his head through the gap. Monica and Chandler are now sitting at the dinner table. There is another smaller table full of food standing in front of the front door) (Monica and Chandler do not look amused by Joeys head in the door)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Oh! It all looks so beautiful: the turkey, the stuffing... (Monica is now smiling)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: The cranberries...?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh! Enough! A monkey could have made 'em!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (still with his door wedged in the door gap, now opens his eyes wide and stares at Monica and Chandler as he did with Ross earlier in the hall) Hey listen guys, we feel really terrible.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: He's doing that weird eye contact thing. Don't look at him, don't look at him! (They both look away)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Come on you guys, we want you to know we're (His eye widen even more) very very sorry. (Monica and Chandler are now covering their eyes with their hands) (then to the others in the hall) Right guys? (Ross head appears above Joey's, Rachel's below Joey's and Phoebe's at the bottom)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I feel terrible.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green: So, so sorry.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (smiling) Now let's not ruin this day. You worked so hard. Let's move past this and try to have a nice meal all together, huh?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: The floating heads do make a good point.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Yeah, they do seem to feel pretty bad.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: So bad.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: So bad.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: So bad.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (Gets up) Okay, okay. You two (to Phoebe and Rachel) go get the dessert. And I'll let you in.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Dessert?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Yeah, I asked you and Phoebe to pick up the pies. You did remember, right?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Pies, oh, we thought you said priiiize (goes to the hall and comes back with Emma's trophy in her hand). Here! (gives it to Monica). (Monica takes it and reads the label)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Grand Supreme Little Darling?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Congratulatioooons!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh my God! YOU FORGOT THE PIES? Well, I cannot believe this. You force me to make dinner, then you're an hour late and you forget the one little thing that I asked you to do.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Really girls, not cool.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Well, you manheads aren't any better. You lied about going to the game. You knew it would make you late, and you still went anyway.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Hey! I'm getting a little tired of this okay? We said we're sorry. It's Thanksgiving for Pete's sakes! A day of forgiveness!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: It's a day to be thankful.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (to Ross, mouthing) Don't make me come up there!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: It's too late for apologies.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Fine! Let's just go. I don't need your stupid dinner.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: That would be a lot more convincing if you weren't drooling.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Ewww, is that what that is?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Sorry!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Come on you guys, let's just do our own Thanksgiving.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Yeah! I'll cook!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Yeah! Let's go out.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: Hey!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah! You three have a nice Thanksgiving.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: The three of us?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah! You, Chan, and the vein! (Monica gasps and holds her forehead. Phoebe, Rachel and Ross pull back their heads)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Ha! (When Joey tries to pull back his head, he notices he is stuck)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Oh-oh! I'm stuck!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Joey, that is not gonna work.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: No seriously... I'm really wedged in here.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: I'll pull you through.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Okay.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (in agony) aaw-ahhh-aaahhh STOP! STOP! I'm worried about damaging my head.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: A little late for that.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Alright, hurry up, you gotta do something.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Alright, well, this does not change anything. (to Chandler) Okay, we need to get something to grease the sides of his face.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Uhm, we've got turkey grease.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Bring it.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I just wanna say that I'm sorry I referred to the vein as a seperate person... (Chandler gives Monica a footlong "eye dropper" with the turkey grease in it)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Here you go! (She squirts some of the grease along Joey's face.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, that smells good! (And he starts licking the grease which trickles down his face. Monica also squirts some on the other side of his face, and his tongue follows her movements.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Okay.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Okay, try it. (Joey tries to pull back at all his might.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: It isn't working.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Alright, we're gonna have to unscrew the chain.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Well hurry, I can't feel my ears!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Can you ever feel your ears?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Interesting...

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Chandler, where are your tools?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (sarcastically) Oh, I left them on my bulldozer... I don't have tools!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: I do, but Rachel borrowed them.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: I lent them to Ross.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: I gave them to Joey.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: I left them at the park.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: (looking at Joey's butt) I'm finding it really hard not to mess with him.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: I've already stuffed a bunch of Brussel sprouts down his pants.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Ross Geller: Nice! (The phone rings in Chandler and Monica's apartment)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Okay, I have to get that. Now when I get back, I want you and your friends to be gone. Thanksgiving is over. The Vein has spoken.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: It's really starting to hurt.

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Okay, look, I'm gonna pull on the door and you guys push as hard as you can. Maybe we can get enough room to wiggle him out, okay? Okay, so PUSH!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Phoebe Buffay: Just a sec., we're kind in the middle of something here. (Rachel, Ross and Phoebe have their hands full and are stuffing all kinds of things down Joeys pants.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Ooh! Stop putting things down my pants!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Come on guys, PUSH!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah! Come on!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller: PUSH! PUSH! PUSH! (The chain breaks loose from the wall, and because Joey was pushing with all his might, he propells into the kitchen, towards the table with all the food. This table has wheels underneath it, and when Joey falls on this table, he rides into the living room, with all the food falling off, until finally Joey also falls off... Joey gets up quickly, a bit agitated, and acting as nothing happened. He is covered in food stains.)

metadata.speaker: Chandler Bing & Joey Tribbiani & Ross Geller

text:
Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: My cranberries!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Joey Tribbiani: (looking at himself) Man, I've got food all over me. (He licks his fingers, liking it. He offers Chandler a taste.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Argh! I can't believe what you did. Monica's gonna kill you! (Monica enters from the spare bedroom.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: (to Monica) Look! Look! Look what the... Look what... Look what the floating heads did!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: (very emotional) I don't care. (Chandler can't believe what he's hearing. He looks at Monica, then at the others, then back at Monica.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: What's going on?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: That was the adoption agency...

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: And?

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: WE'RE GETTING A BABY!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Are you serious? (they hug)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: There's a pregnant woman in Ohio, and she picked us! (They all cheer and Rachel, Ross and Phoebe join in for a group hug. Joey also joins, but he stands back a bit, because he is all sticky of the food on him)

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Rachel Green: I'm so happy for you!

Friends S10E08, Scene 8
Monica Geller: This Thanksgiving kicks last Thanksgiving's ass! (They all cheer and hug again, but Joey's eating the food off his shirt)

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Rachel Green: To Monica and Chandler... and that knocked up girl in Ohio.

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Ross Geller: I'm just so happy you guys are finally getting a kid.

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: I know. Have you considered pageanting?

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Monica Geller: I can't believe they called, and we're actually getting a baby. (she kisses Chandler)

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, I know how you feel... (Monica and Chandler are looking curiously at Joey.)

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Really?

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Sure. I went through the exact same thing with Alicia Mae Emory... The waiting, the wandering... Then one day... I get that call from Toys "R" Us... She was in stock!

Friends S10E08, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: That is the exact same thing.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Hi!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Hey!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Hey!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: We're just here to say goodbye, we're off to Ohio.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, right! Your adoption interview!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Yep, we're gonna meet the lady who could be carrying our baby.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani: I can't believe it. When you guys come back, you're gonna have a baby! That is so weird!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: And so incorrect!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: She's only a couple of months pregnant. She liked our application but who knows if she's gonna like us.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Ross Geller: Come on, she's gonna love you guys!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Uhm, thank you, but we're really trying not to get our hopes up.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: And a lot could still get in our way.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Yeah. I mean, this girl could decide against adoption or she could like another couple better..

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Phoebe Buffay: What are you gonna name the baby?

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: I can develop a condition in which I talk and talk and no one hears a word.

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Joey Tribbiani: But just think, ok? What if everything goes right? What if this woman does pick you guys?

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Oh my God. She's gonna pick us!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: So we're standing firm on the 'not getting our hopes up'?

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: You know, I know that things could still go wrong but if they don't? If this works out, we're gonna have a baby Chandler, a baby!

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Yes, but...

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Monica Geller: Oh my God, it's gonna WORK! We're gonna make it work! I'm gonna be a mummy and (to Chandler) you're gonna be a daddy! All right, I'll see you suckers. I'm gonna get me... A BABY! {she leaves)

Friends S10E09, Scene 1
Chandler Bing: Oh, screw it, I'm gonna be a daddy!!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: (to Joey) Hey, who's Phoebe with?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I'm gonna say someone I'm gonna have sex with. (the girl leaves and Phoebe goes toward the couch) (to Phoebe) Hey!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Hey!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: So... who's your friend?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, that's Sarah. No, no. Don't you get any ideas, ok? No, I'm not setting you up with any more of my friends!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: OW, why, why, why?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Because you'll date her once, sleep with her and then forget she exists!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, name one friend of yours that I did that with.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Mandy.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Mandy, uh? Uh... really hot blonde, big boobs?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: No.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I know why I don't remember her, huh? (he winks at Rachel)

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Do you think I'm someone else?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Ok, I may not have treated your friends well in the past, but I have grown up a lot, really. Honest, Rach?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well, believe it or not, it's true. When Joey and I were together, he was wonderful. He was thoughtful and mature. And for the one week that we went out, he didn't sleep with anybody else!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: (pointing at himself) Growth!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Fine, I'll give you her number.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Ok, thank you. And I promise you I will not forget this one. (he starts writing on his hand) Mandy.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: SARAH!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Saraaah.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (entering) Hey!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey you guys, I need some fashion advice.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Oh!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: (he takes a baby blue beret out of a shopping box and puts it on) How does this look?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Well, it's a little low... pick up a little... (Ross picks it up) a little bit more... (he picks it up again) a little bit more... (he takes it off) There you go! (pause) Now throw it away!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: C'mon! This looks good!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Ross, please, trust me. I buy 30 fashion magazines a month. Now, I don't know who's running for president or who that... NATO guy is, but I do know that you have to get as far away as you can from that hat.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Damnit! I have this date tomorrow night and I have to look cool!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Phoebe Buffay: Well, you know, if you want fashion help, Rachel and I are going shopping tomorrow. You're more than welcome to come with us, right?

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Really? That would be great. I mean, I have to do something, she kinda teased me about how I dress.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: I can see why, nice shirt!

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Ross Geller: You're wearing the same shirt.

Friends S10E09, Scene 2
Joey Tribbiani: Stupid Gap on every corner!

Friends S10E09, Scene 3
Agency Guy: Please, make yourself comfortable and I will back in a moment with Erica.

Friends S10E09, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Ok, thank you.(the man leaves) Uh, well this is it. Are you OK?

Friends S10E09, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Yeah. Just weird, you know. It's like: "Hi, I'm Chandler. May I have the human growing inside you?"

Rachel Green: What?! (He walks over and kisses her. They pull back, Rachel looks at him, and they kiss again.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Hey.

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Shh.. Go back to sleep. I have to go home.

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Oh. This was amazing.

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Rachel Green: It really was. You've learned some new moves!

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Yeah, well, this guy at work gave me "Sex for Dummies" as a joke.

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Rachel Green: Ah.

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Ross Geller: Who's laughing now?

Friends S10E17, Scene 2
Rachel Green: I know! (They kiss.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Breathe, breathe, breathe... Good.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Next time, can I say breathe?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: No, last time you said it like Dracula, and it scared her! Can I get you anything? You want some more ice chips?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Erica: No, I'm okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: Alright, I'll be right back.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Where are you going?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: To use the bathroom.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: You can't leave me alone with her.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: This is exactly the kind of social situation that I am not comfortable with!

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: What kind of social situation are you comfortable with?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: It's just that we've never spent any time, you know, alone together.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Monica Geller: You'll be fine. Nah, you won't, but I'll be back in two minutes.

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Okay. (Monica leaves, and Chandler closes the door. Erica just looks at him.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: So, ah... Any plans for the summer?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Erica: I don't know. Maybe church-camp?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Hah. May not wanna mention this. So, you ever wonder which is worse, you know; going through labor or getting kicked in the nuts?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Erica: What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: Well, it's just interesting. You know, because no one will ever know, because no one can experience both. (Erica just looks at him like he's crazy.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 3
Chandler Bing: One of life's great, unanswerable questions. I mean, who knows? Maybe there's something even more painful than those things? Like this.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Morning.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: What's that?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: It's my house-warming present for Monica and Chandler.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: It's a baby chick and duck!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Uh-huh. And I named them Chick Jr. and Duck Jr.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: I did not see that coming.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, I figure they'll love it at the new house, you know? It has that big backyard. And then, when they get old, they can go to that special farm that Chandler took the other chick and duck to.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Yes.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah. It's a shame people can't visit there.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: That is the rule, though. (Ross enters.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Guess what? You're almost an uncle!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, Erica went into labor last night. Monica and Chandler are at the hospital right now!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Oh my God!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, and I have a definite feeling it's gonna be a girl.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Phoebe, you were sure Ben was gonna be a girl.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Have you seen him throw a ball?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Is Rachel here?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Uh, I think she's still asleep. Hey, hey, how did it go with you guys last night? She seemed pretty pissed at you.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Uh, we, y'know, we worked things out.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: What's that smile? Did something happen with you two?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Hey, I'm not one to kiss and tell, but I'm also not one to have sex and shut up. We totally did it!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Oh my God. You and Rachel?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: I know, it's pretty great.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: So what does that mean? Are you guys getting back together?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Oh, I.. I don't know. We didn't really get to talk.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: But do you wanna get back together?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: I don't know. It was incredible. I mean, it just felt so right. When I was holding her, I mean, I never wanted to let her go. You know what? Yeah, I do. I wanna be together.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: (screaming) YAY!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Shhh!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: (quietly) Yay!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: So, so is she still going to Paris?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Wow, I hadn't thought of that. I hope not.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Oh, this is like the best day ever. Ever! You guys might get back together, Monica and Chandler are getting their baby, there are chicks and ducks in the world again! Oh, I feel like I'm in a musical! (Singing) "Daa - raa... When the sun comes up, bright and beaming! And the moon comes..." (Rachel enters from her room.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Morning!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: Guess we'll never know how it ends.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Hey.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Hey.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Hey. How did you sleep?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Good. You?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Good.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: I bet you did!

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Uh. Would you guys mind giving us a minute?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Joey Tribbiani: Sure, yeah. Will you just keep an eye on the chick and the duck?

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Chick and the duck? Didn't they die...

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Phoebe Buffay: (interrupting) Dive. Yeah, they dove head-first into fun on the farm. (Joey and Phoebe leave.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: So... (He kisses her.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: Morning.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: You too. Last night was just wonderful.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: It really was.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: I woke up today with the biggest smile on my face.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Ross Geller: I know, me too. It was... You know, it was like one of those things you think is never gonna happen, and then it does, and it's everything you want it to be.

Friends S10E17, Scene 4
Rachel Green: Uh-huh. I know. It was just, it was just the perfect way to say goodbye. (She hugs him, and Ross looks crushed.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: It's just a little bit more, honey.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Erica: Help me! This hurts!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Is it really that bad?

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Erica: Uh-huh! I think it's time to kick you in the nuts and see which is worse! (Monica gives Chandler a look.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: The baby's head is crowning. (Monica walks down to Erica's legs to watch the birth.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh! Oh my God! That is the most beautiful top of a head I have ever seen! Chandler, you have to see this! (Chandler is standing by Erica's head.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: I'm okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Chandler, you don't wanna miss this. This is the birth of your child! It's the miracle of life!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Alright. Wow, that is one disgusting miracle.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: Start pushing. Here we go. Here come the shoulders... (The baby starts crying, and the doctor holds it up.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: It's a... It's a boy!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Wow!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Erica: Is he okay?

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: He's just fine.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: Oh, you did it!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: (emotional) It's a baby! A beautiful little baby! And some other stuff I'm gonna pretend I don't see.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: Would you like to cut the umbilical cord? (A nurse gives Monica a pair of scissors. Monica gives it to Chandler, and they cut it together.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Well, that's spongy.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: (to her son) Oh, hey handsome! Oh, I'm gonna love you so much that no woman is ever gonna be good enough for you! (To Chandler, on the verge of tears) Oh, we are so lucky!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: I know. He has your eyes. (Monica looks at him.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: I mean, I know that's not possible, but he does.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Nurse: We'll just get him cleaned up a bit. (The doctor hands the boy to the nurse, and she walks over to another part of the room with him.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: (To Erica) Oh my God, he's beautiful. Thank you so much.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Erica: I'm really happy for you guys.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: How do you feel?

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Erica: I'm tired!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: Well, you don't have that much time to relax. The other one will be along in a minute. (Chandler stares at the doctor, completely shocked. Monica just freezes and turns around slowly.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: I... I'm sorry, who should be along in a what now?

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: The next baby should be along in a minute.

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Monica Geller: We only ordered one!

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Doctor: You know it's twins, right?

Friends S10E17, Scene 5
Chandler Bing: Oh, yeah! These are the faces of two people in the know!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: I can't believe you didn't know it's twins! This has never happened before.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Well, gosh. That makes me feel so special and good.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: (to the doctor) Wait, did you know it was twins?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: Yeah, it's here in the paperwork we got from the clinic in Ohio.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: (to Erica) Anybody tell you?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Erica: I don't think so. Although, they did mention something about two heartbeats. But I thought that was just mine and the baby's. They kept saying both heartbeats are really strong, and I thought well, that's good 'cause I'm having a baby.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: This is unbelievable.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Erica: Twins actually run in my family.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Interesting! (To Monica) Can I see you for a second? (They walk over to the door.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: What do we do?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: What do you mean "what do we do"?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: (panicking) Twins! Twins!!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Chandler, you're panicking!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Uh-huh! Join me, won't you?! Okay, what do you say we keep one, and then just like have an option on the other one?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: We can't split them up!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Why not? We could give each of them half a medallion, and then years later, they'll find each other and be reunited. I mean, that's a great day for everybody.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Okay, what if the person who adopts the other one is horrible?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: What if they're not? What if it's adopted by a king?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Yeah, because I hear the king is looking to adopt.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Monica, we are not ready to have two babies!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: That doesn't matter! We have waited so long for this. I don't care if it's two babies. I don't care if it's three babies! I don't care if the entire cast of "Eight is Enough" comes out of there! We are taking them home, because they are our children!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: (smiles) Okay. Shhh... (He hugs her.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Monica Geller: Okay!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: Okay!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: It looks like we're about ready over here. (Monica and Chandler run back to Erica's bed.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: Come on, Erica, start pushing again now.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Erica: Ow! (Erica screams.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: Here she comes!

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: (shocked) She? It's a girl?

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Doctor: Yeah.

Friends S10E17, Scene 6
Chandler Bing: (To Monica) Well, now we have one of each! (To the doctor) And that's enough!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: And then she said it was the perfect way to say goodbye.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh my God! What did you say?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Nothing! What do you say to that?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Ross, you've got to tell her how you feel!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: No way!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: You can't just give up! Is that what a dinosaur would do?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Dude, I'm just trying to speak your language.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Ross, Rachel doesn't know that you wanna get back together. If she did, she might feel differently. She might not even go.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: You really think so?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: I'm telling you! Oh, okay! This is the part of the musical where there'd be a really good convincing song. (Singing) "Bam-bam, don't take no for an answer. Bam-bam, don't let love fly away. Bam-bam-bam-bam..." (Rachel enters and interrupts Phoebe's song.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: Hi!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Can't a girl finish a song around here?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Hey!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: Hi! So I just dropped Emma off at my mom's.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, you're not taking her with you tonight?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: No, we decided that I would go ahead and set up first, and then my mom would bring Emma to Paris on Sunday.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Wow, eight hour flight with a one-year old? Good luck, mom.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: Are you kidding? Eight hours with my mother talking about Atkins? Good luck, Emma! (Rachel walks up to the counter.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Alright, you know what? You're right. I should at least tell her how I feel. (He stands up.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Ross, wait!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: What? What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Could you get me a muffin? (Ross walks up to Rachel, but Gunther gets there first.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Gunther: Rachel?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: Yeah?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Gunther: I... I know you're leaving tonight, but I just have to tell you. I love you. (Ross is shocked.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Gunther: I... I don't know if that changes your plans at all, but I thought you should know.

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: (touched) Gunther... Oh... I love you too. Probably not in the same way, but I do. And, and when I'm in a cafe, having coffee, or I see a man with hair brighter than the sun, I'll think of you. Aw. (She kisses him on the cheek and looks over at the others.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Rachel Green: Oh... Bye guys. (Rachel leaves.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: Oh my God!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Phoebe Buffay: Unbelievable!

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, you know what might help?

Friends S10E17, Scene 7
Ross Geller: I'm not getting you a muffin!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Do you think they recognize each other from in there?

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Maybe. Unless they're like two people who have lived in apartments next to each other for years, and then one day they're pushed through a vagina and they meet.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Nurse: We're going to take Erica to recovery now.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: There's something that we wanna tell you. We decided to name the girl-baby Erica.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Erica: Oh my God, that's just like my name!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Son of a gun, it is!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Erica: Anyway, I'm gonna go and get some rest. I'm really glad I picked you guys. You're gonna make great parents. Even Chandler.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Okay, well, bye!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Erica: Bye!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Bye!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: We'll call you!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Erica: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Have fun at church-camp! (The nurses take Erica to the recovery room. Monica and Chandler smile at each other.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Oh, look at these little bunnies!

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: I know! You ready to trade?

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: Okay.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Alright, let's see.. (They start trying to trade babies while holding one each. They have no idea how to do it, so they just shift the babies around in their arms. They give up pretty quickly.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Chandler Bing: We could trade later.

Friends S10E17, Scene 8
Monica Geller: Yeah, I'm good.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Hey, what are you working on?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: It's a... It's a "welcome home" sign for the baby. (He holds up a white poster with huge red letters. It reads, "Welcome Home Baby." There is also a huge red stain on the left of the poster.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: How sweet! Oh, is that the baby? (She points at the stain.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: No, I sat in the paint. (Ross enters with a gift for the baby.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Hey.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Hey. So, did you talk to Rachel?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: No, and I'm not going to.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: What?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Why not?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Because she's just going to shoot me down. You guys saw what happened with Gunther. That did not look like fun.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: How can you compare yourself to Gunther? I mean, sure, he's sexy in a more obvious way. You have a relationship with her, you slept together last night.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Yeah, and she still wants to go! It's pretty clear where she is.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Yeah, I know what you mean. I mean, sometimes... (He sits down in the wet paint again.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Uh, Joe?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Damn it!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Look, even if I were gonna tell her, I don't have to do it now. Okay? I'll be seeing her again. We've got time.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: No, you don't! She's going to Paris! She is going to meet somebody. Do you know how many hot guys there are in Paris? It's... It's a city of Gunthers! (Mike enters with a roll of paper in his hand.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Mike Hannigan: Hey!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Hey! What do you have there?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Mike Hannigan: Oh, I made a little something. If I had more time to work on it, it'd be better, but.. (He shows them a beautiful banner he has made. It reads, "Welcome to the World, Baby Bing.")

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Oh my God! You did that yourself?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Honey, that's gorgeous!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: You know, the baby can't read, Mike! (Rachel enters.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Hi! You guys, the car-service just got here. I can't believe they're not home yet! I have to catch my stupid plane. I wanna see the baby!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Monica just called from the cab. She said they should be here any minute. And apparently, there's some big surprise.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay: Yeah, did she sound happy about it? 'Cause my friend Ethel's baby was born with a teeny, tiny beard. (Monica enters carrying her son.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh my God!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Oh my God! (They all walk over to see the baby.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Hi! Oh my gosh! (Chandler enters carrying his daughter.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Hey. (Everybody turns around.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green & Ross Geller: Hey. (They turn back around to see the baby Monica's carrying, but then they realise what the surprise is. Ross, Mike, Phoebe and Rachel gasp and stare at Chandler and his baby. Joey hasn't figured it out yet.)

metadata.speaker: Phoebe Buffay & Rachel Green & Ross Geller

text:
Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: (To Monica) Hey, so what is the big surprise?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Oh. (Joey stares at Chandler and Monica and finally puts two and two together. He gasps.)

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Oh my God!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: What... What...

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Okay, okay, awkward question. The hospital knows you took two, right?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Yes, it's twins!

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Oh my God.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Oh, they're so cute! Now, what, what kinds are they?

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Monica Geller: (points at the baby she's holding) This is a boy, (points at the baby Chandler is holding) and that's a girl.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Her name is Erica.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Rachel Green: Aw..

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Joey Tribbiani: Hey, that pregnant girl's name was Erica.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Chandler Bing: Yeah. It's a shame you two didn't get to spend more time together.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Monica Geller: Yeah, we named the boy Jack after dad.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
Ross Geller: Aw, he's gonna be so happy.

Friends S10E17, Scene 9
